plugins.description: Custom video startup intro for DeepSeek Harness: import clips, tune playback, cross-fade into the workbench, follows the app light/dark appearance.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Startup Intro · 启动开场动画 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 加一个可自定义视频的启动开场：导入自己的视频素材，选中哪段，之后每次启动就播哪段；片段、速度、亮度、画面适配、影院填充、展示比例与淡出时长都能调，支持实时预览；播完交叉淡出，直接过渡到工作台。动画还会**跟随 DSH 的浅色 / 深色外观自动选版**。 A video-powered boot intro plugin for DeepSeek Harness: import clips, keep per-clip playback settings, preview live in Settings, then cross-fade into the workbench at every launch. Ships with a procedurally generated demo intro (dark & light cuts). ![启动开场](docs/boot.gif)

## 功能 - **视频素材库**：导入本地视频（`mp4` / `webm` / `mov` 等 Chromium 能解码的格式），删除、切换选中；每段素材各自保存一套参数。 - **启动即播**：直接播放原视频（不做 GIF 转换、不重新编码），播完约 0.8–1.2s 交叉淡出露出 DSH 界面；播放中可点击「跳过开场」。 - **参数调节**：起始位置、播放时长、播放速度、亮度、画面适配（铺满 / 完整）、影院填充（用同一段视频的模糊背景补满画面）、展示比例（播到哪一刻开始淡出）、淡出时长、静音。 - **实时预览**：设置页内嵌预览随参数即时变化；「播放完整开场效果」可在全屏跑一遍完整启动流程。 - **深浅色自动切换**：跟随 DSH 的外观（`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`）自动选择深色版 / 浅色版同一素材；设置页预览也会随外观实时换版。 - **数据都在本机**：素材与参数保存在 `~/.dsh/startup-intro/`，卸载插件不会删除素材。 ## 安装 先确认 `dsh` 可用（DeepSeek Harness 自带 CLI，Electron 桌面版安装目录 `resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`）。 ### 方式一：目录安装（推荐） ```bash git clone https://github.com/zoe1nan/dsh-startup-intro.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-startup-intro ``` ### 方式二：打包安装 ```bash pnpm pack # 或 npm pack，得到 dsh-startup-intro-1.1.0.tgz dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-startup-intro-1.1.0.tgz ``` > 若 pnpm 报 `[ERR_PNPM_UNKNOWN] ... open '.../pnpm/store/...'`，改用目录安装即可绕过（本地 link 依赖）。 安装完成后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（Electron 桌面版重启才会加载新 bundle）。打开 设置 → 启动开场 即可看到插件页面。 ## 使用 1. 设置（`Ctrl+Alt+,`）→ 左侧「启动开场」。 2. 点「导入视频」，选择本地视频；导入后自动选中，下次启动就播放它。 3. 调整参数——右侧预览实时生效；点「播放完整开场效果」可在全屏看完整流程。 4. 右上「每次启动播放」可临时关闭开场；「恢复默认参数」重置当前素材。 ## 预置演示素材 `demo/` 下是两段程序化生成的示例开场（1920×1080 / 8.8s / 30fps，各 2–3 MB）： | 文件 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `demo/startup-intro-dark.mp4` | 深色外观版：深蓝夜空 + 轨道环 + 原生小蓝鲸 | | `demo/startup-intro-light.mp4` | 浅色外观版：纸面蓝墨 + 同构图的墨色鲸 | 一键写入本机素材库并选中： ```bash node tools/seed-demo.mjs ``` 也可以直接在设置页「导入视频」里选这两个文件。生成源码见 `demo/source/intro-art.html`（`?t=` 可定位到任意帧，`&theme=light` 输出浅色版）。 ## 深浅色自动切换 素材条目支持可选的 `lightFile` 字段（同一素材的浅色版）： ```jsonc // ~/.dsh/startup-intro/state.json { "version": 1, "enabled": true, "selectedId": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be", "videos": [ { "id": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be", "name": "DEEPSEEK HARNESS 开场.mp4", "file": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be.mp4", "lightFile": "v9f2b7c4e1a8d3605c7be-light.mp4", "meta": { "duration": 8.8, "width": 1920, "height": 1080 }, "params": { "start": 0, "duration": 8.8, "speed": 1, "brightness": 1, "fit": "cover", "cinema": true, "holdRatio": 0.83, "fadeMs": 1200, "muted": true } } ] } ``` 把浅色版文件放进 `~/.dsh/startup-intro/media/`，并在对应条目加上 `lightFile` 即可：深色外观播 `file`，浅色外观播 `lightFile`。不填 `lightFile` 时两种外观播放同一文件。 ## 实现 ``` index.js Host 半边：状态 / 上传 / 删除 / 媒体直出路由 client.js Client 半边：启动浮层（shell.overlay）+ 设置页（settings.section） cordis.patch.yml bundle 挂载声明 locale/{zh,en}.json 设置页导航与插件卡片的标题 / 描述 icon.svg 插件图标 demo/ 示例开场素材与生成源码 tools/seed-demo.mjs 把 demo 素材写入本机素材库 ``` - Host：`ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'prefix', path: '/startup-intro' })` 提供 `GET/POST /api/state`、`POST /api/upload`、`POST /api/delete`、`GET /media/`（支持 `Range` / 206）。 所有请求都会先过 `connection.requestRejection(req)`，未授权直接 401。 - Client：`ctx.slots.inject('shell.overlay', ...)` 注册启动浮层（`createPortal` 到 body，保证盖过启动弹窗）； `ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', ...)` 注册设置页。用 `MutationObserver` 监听 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 切换素材版本。 - 不使用插件 Config 字段：素材与参数放 `~/.dsh/startup-intro/state.json`，由设置页自己读写。 ## 开发与调试 不想污染现有 profile 时，可以起一个独立测试实例： ```bash # 用内置模板建一个独立 profile（与 desktop 隔离） dsh introtest --from-default-profile web --dump-config dsh plugin --profile introtest add /path/to/dsh-startup-intro # 启动测试实例（--no-open 不弹窗，输出带 token 的调试 URL） dsh introtest --no-open --port 63411 # 用完清理 rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/introtest ``` - 改 `client.js` / `index.js`：刷新页面即可生效（客户端 bundle 每次加载时重新取）。 - 改 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`：需要重启实例。 示例开场的生成源码在 `demo/source/intro-art.html`：纯 canvas 2D 程序化动画，`?t=<毫秒>` 可定格任意帧，`&theme=light` 输出浅色版。逐帧截图后再用 ffmpeg 编码即可（仓库未附渲染脚本，按你的环境选 Edge headless / Playwright）。 ## 兼容性 - DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Electron，web profile）实测；Web 版同理，需注意浏览器自动播放策略（默认静音即可自动播放，取消静音后可能被拦截）。 - 视频解码走 Chromium 内置解码器：H.264/AAC 的 mp4 在桌面版可播；是否支持 HEVC/AV1 取决于 Harness 内置 Chromium 构建。 ## 已知限制 - 桌面端**重启 Harness 后**才加载 / 更新插件（插件在启动时装配，不支持运行中热插拔）。 - 素材保存在本机，不随插件同步；换机器需要重新导入。 - 导入文件大小上限 2 GiB（Host 侧限制）。 ## License MIT

plugins.description: bilibili-note 的 DSH 插件封装版（衍生自 3588834014-del/bilibili-note）：把 B站视频链接变成 Obsidian 结构化笔记，只拉字幕不下载视频。
plugins.readme_text:
# bilibili-note

> **DSH plugin packaging of [`3588834014-del/bilibili-note`](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note).**
>
> This repository is the **plugin edition**: the upstream project plus a DeepSeek Harness
> bundle wrapper (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib/index.js`). The original
> skill + CLI lives upstream — use that one if you don't need to install it as a dsh plugin.
> GitHub does not allow forking a repository into the same account, so this is a derivative
> copy rather than a fork-network fork.

> **Turn Bilibili videos into structured Obsidian notes — subtitles only, never the video.**
>
> 中文说明见 [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)。

[![CI](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.8+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

A small CLI — plus an optional agent skill — that turns a Bilibili video into a structured
Markdown note in your Obsidian vault. It downloads **only the subtitle file** (`--skip-download`),
cleans the timestamps, and writes a note with YAML front matter, a summary section, bullet
points carrying clickable `?t=` jump links, and the full transcript collapsed at the bottom.

The repetitive half (fetch, parse, format, verify) is a script. The judgment half (summary,
key points, tags) is left as a documented contract you or an agent fill in.

```
Bilibili URL ──▶ fetch ──▶ manifest.json ──▶ [you / agent] ──▶ content.json ──▶ write ──▶ note.md
                  │         subtitles +                      summary, bullets,       │
                  │         timestamped segments             tags                    │
                  └── yt-dlp, subtitles only ────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Real output

`fetch` on a real video — note what is *not* there: no `.mp4`, `.flv`, `.m4a` or `.part`,
only the subtitle file and its manifest.

![fetch: subtitles only, no media files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-fetch.png)

And the note it produces (Obsidian rendering — front matter, clickable `?t=` jump links,
summary, bullets, tags). Screenshot taken from a real run, not a mock-up:

![the generated note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note/main/docs/images/demo-note.png)

## Why this one

- **Subtitles only.** `--skip-download` is mandatory, and the tool verifies no media file
  (`.mp4/.flv/.m4a/.part`) landed in the working directory. No reverse-engineering, no
  private APIs — just `yt-dlp`.
- **Multi-part videos are merged.** For an anthology (B站 分P 合集) it fetches every part's
  subtitles and rebases the timestamps onto one continuous timeline. Verified on a real
  6-part anthology: **2:10:32 → 2807 segments / 33214 characters**, matching an independent
  concatenation segment-for-segment. A part with no subtitles is skipped **while keeping its
  time slot**, so later timestamps stay correct.
- **It refuses to produce garbage.** If two parts yield byte-identical subtitles, it errors out
  instead of silently emitting a note whose content is one part repeated N times. (That exact
  bug shipped during development and was caught by this guard.)
- **No subtitles? It skips and tells you.** It never fabricates content or writes an empty note.

## Install

No dependencies — standard library only. `yt-dlp` is an **external command**, not a Python package.

### As a DSH plugin (recommended for DeepSeek Harness)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:3588834014-del/bilibili-note-plugin
```

This is a **bundle plugin** that registers the `bilibili-note` skill straight into the DSH skill
catalog — no manual copying into `~/.agents/skills`. Restart your profile afterwards and the
skill is available; the model picks it up from phrases like 「B站笔记」 or a pasted BV link.

The plugin ships its own copy of `scripts/bili_note.py`, `docs/` and `SKILL.md`, and rewrites
the `<skill-dir>` placeholders in the skill body to the **absolute install path**, so the model
never has to guess where the script lives. Uninstall with
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bilibili-note`.

> There is no npm package yet, so this plugin is **source-installed** — it is listed on
> [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org) but will not appear in the in-app plugin store.
> pnpm ≥10 may ask you to allow the git dependency's build script; this package has no
> `prepare` script, so nothing runs at install time.

### As a standalone CLI

```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
# or
git clone https://github.com/3588834014-del/bilibili-note.git
cd bilibili-note && python -m pip install .
```

Then:

```bash
bili-note --version
bili-note note "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BVxxxxxxxxx" \
    --note-dir ~/MyVault/Sources/Videos
```

### As a plain agent skill (no plugin)

```bash
python scripts/install.py            # installs to ~/.agents/skills/bilibili-note
python scripts/install.py --dry-run  # show what would be copied
```

The skill then appears in the dsh skill catalog and can be triggered with phrases like
「B站笔记」. The plugin, the skill-file install and the CLI all share the same implementation
(`scripts/bili_note.py`).

### Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| Python 3.8+ | stdlib only |
| [`yt-dlp`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) | `pip install -U yt-dlp` — the **only** download channel |
| Bilibili login cookies | Required for AI subtitles; see below |
| DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` | Only for the plugin/skill route |

### Permissions and external services

Worth knowing before you install, since this tool touches the network and your vault:

- **Network**: talks to `bilibili.com` through `yt-dlp` only. It downloads **subtitles**, never
  video or audio (`--skip-download` is mandatory and verified).
- **Credentials**: reads a Bilibili cookie file from `$BILI_COOKIES` or `./cookies.txt`. It
  writes a **normalized temporary copy** next to the work dir for yt-dlp; it never uploads,
  logs, or commits cookies.
- **Filesystem**: writes notes into the `--note-dir` you pass, plus a scratch work directory.
  Nothing outside those two paths is modified.
- **No telemetry, no extra dependencies**, no reverse-engineered APIs.

## Cookies (required)

Bilibili's AI-subtitle endpoint needs an authenticated session.

1. Install the **Get cookies.txt LOCALLY** browser extension.
2. Log into [bilibili.com](https://www.bilibili.com).
3. Export `cookies.txt`.
4. Put it in your working directory, or point at it:

```bash
export BILI_COOKIES=/path/to/cookies.txt      # Linux / macOS
$env:BILI_COOKIES = "C:\path\cookies.txt"     # PowerShell
```

Videos where the uploader supplied their own subtitles may work without this.

### ⚠️ Why you can't feed the export straight to yt-dlp

This is the single most surprising thing in this repository. That extension writes lines like:

```
.bilibili.com	FALSE	/	FALSE	1819635894	SESSDATA	xxxxx
```

The domain carries a leading dot, yet the host-only flag in column 2 is `FALSE`. Python's
`http.cookiejar` asserts:

```python
assert domain_specified == initial_dot
```

The mismatch raises, and yt-dlp refuses to load the **entire file**:

```
ERROR: invalid Netscape format cookies file '...': '.bilibili.com\tFALSE\t/...'
```

The practical symptom is nasty: subtitles never arrive, and the error looks like
*"this video has no subtitles."* The fix is normalization — strip the leading dot and set the
flag to `FALSE` (a host-only cookie is still sent to `api.bilibili.com` and friends, so the
session is preserved). `normalize_cookies()` does this, plus filters to the `bilibili` domain
and de-duplicates by `domain/path/name`. You never have to do it by hand.

## Output directory

Nothing is hard-coded. Pick either:

```bash
bili-note note "<URL>" --note-dir "<vault>/Sources/Videos"    # explicit

export BILI_VAULT="/path/to/MyVault"                           # or environment
export BILI_TARGET_DIR="Sources/Videos"

plugins.description: 复杂项目模式 preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the standard tool stack plus a four-document policy, current-state-only docs, a no-unrequested-push rule, careful coding, and plain-language reporting.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-complex-project-preset

**An agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the full standard tool stack, plus the discipline to think before it types.**

> 中文版: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

The whole preset lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml): it inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row into the profile and registers a preset with the id `complex-project`. The package ships **configuration only** — no host code, no browser UI — so there is very little that an upgrade can break.

---

## Why

The standard preset gets work done, but it will not hold a line on its own: diffs creep, project docs turn into changelogs, and code goes up before you said so.

This preset writes four rules into the persona prompt, so every session starts with them already in force:

| Rule | In one line |
| --- | --- |
| Four documents | A project keeps at most four docs: intro, decisions, change log, current state & next steps |
| Current state only | No AI edit history, no superseded decisions, no leftover "stage 1–5" wording |
| Commit/push red line | No `git commit`, `git push`, or PR until you explicitly say so |
| Careful coding + plain language | Restate the goal and the done-criteria first, make surgical diffs, lead reports with the conclusion |

## What's inside

The tool stack matches the standard preset — bash/pwsh chosen per platform, file read/write and search, tasks and background jobs, skills, plan mode, compaction, subagents and workflows, web fetch, the TODO tool, present. What differs is the persona prompt and the documentation rules:

- `persona` — the four-document policy, current-state-only docs, the commit/push red line, the careful-coding rules, and plain-language reporting;
- `agent-instructions` — still loads your global `AGENTS.md` (64 KB cap);
- `planning` / `compaction` / `delegation` — same groups and isolation settings as standard;
- `tool-plugin-manager` — disabled, so the agent cannot rewrite its own plugin tree.

> ⚠️ The persona block deliberately sets **no `suffix`**. DSH registers only `provider` and `model` as prompt variables; any other `{{name}}` throws during prompt assembly and the whole turn fails before a single request is sent. The working directory is injected by the runtime context already, so declaring it here is redundant as well as fatal.

## Install

```sh
# from npm (recommended — prebuilt install, no build approval)
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-complex-project-preset

# or from the repository / a local directory
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sueqet/dsh-complex-project-preset
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<local-dir>
```

**Restart the profile** (run `dsh web` again, or restart the desktop app) — a preset is a row in the profile composition, not a runtime hot-load.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-complex-project-preset`

### Conflicts with a hand-rolled copy

If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` already declares `- id: preset-complex-project` by hand, installing this package registers the same preset twice and DSH reports `Duplicate agent preset: complex-project`. To switch over:

1. delete that `- id: preset-complex-project ...` block from your `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-complex-project-preset`;
3. restart the profile.

Only one package should provide `complex-project` at a time.

### Version requirement

Requires **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2** (the preset registry `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` joins the base composition there) and **Node.js ≥ 22.19.0**. Verified on DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and on the desktop build 0.2.1-rc.2.

The Node floor is the harness's own rather than this package's: DSH compositions call `process.getBuiltinModule`, which Node ships from 22.3 onwards. This package is a manifest plus one YAML patch — no host code, no browser code, no install-time scripts — so it never loads JavaScript of its own, and the floor only mirrors where DSH can run at all.

## Verify

After a restart, open the mode picker for a new session: **复杂项目模式** (order 2, right after the standard preset) should be listed. Start a session with it and ask about the project's current state — the answer should talk in terms of the four documents rather than freeform.

From the CLI you can also inspect the composed tree:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 preset-complex-project
```

## Develop

```sh
npm test          # checks manifest + cordis.patch.yml consistency, including !!js parsing
npm pack --dry-run
```

`tools/smoke.mjs` verifies that `dsh.bundle.patch` points at a file that exists, that `repository` points back at this repo, that every required preset field is present, that child row ids are unique, and that the persona prompt is neither truncated nor carrying a stray `suffix`. It parses the patch with the harness's own `loadOverlayPatches` when available, so `!!js` expressions behave exactly as they do at boot.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 sueqet

plugins.description: bioRxiv preprint search, version/status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-biorxiv

bioRxiv preprint search, version/publication status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.

> Status: `0.1.0-alpha` — functional core, not a 1.0 release. Relevance evaluation is provisional; do not treat it as peer-reviewed evidence.

## Tools

- `biorxiv_search` — search bioRxiv preprints by topic, optional date window and field. Default `minScore=3` filters low-confidence text matches; set `minScore=0` for higher recall.
- `biorxiv_paper` — DOI lookup: latest version, publication DOI/journal, retraction flag when available.
- `biorxiv_latest` — latest preprints by date window and optional category.
- `biorxiv_export` — export search results or one DOI as JSON, Markdown, CSV or BibTeX.
- `biorxiv_digest` — structured markdown digest (extractive by default; optional opt-in Chinese summaries; no automatic delivery).

All tools return a stable envelope:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {},
  "error": { "code": "", "message": "", "retryable": false, "hint": "" },
  "meta": { "requestId": "...", "elapsedMs": 12, "cached": false, "source": ["europepmc"], "warnings": [] }
}
```

On failure `ok` is `false`, `data` is `{}`, and `error.code` is one of `E-001`–`E-010`.

## Install (one command)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add github:TYEclipse/dsh-biorxiv#v0.1.0-alpha.20
```

Replace `headless` with the target profile. `dsh plugin add` is a pnpm forwarder: a `--profile` is required, and `pnpm` must be on `PATH`.

Build from source instead:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile headless add "file:$PWD/$(ls -t dsh-biorxiv-*.tgz | head -1)"
```

Verify:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless list
dsh --profile headless "Use biorxiv_search to search for 'protein language model' and report the first title and DOI."
```

`dsh plugin add` is a pnpm forwarder: a `--profile` is required, and `pnpm` must be on `PATH`.

## CLI

```bash
dsh-biorxiv search "protein language model" --limit 5
dsh-biorxiv paper 10.64898/2026.07.21.739963
dsh-biorxiv latest --days 2 --limit 10
dsh-biorxiv export "hippocampal ripple" --format markdown --out refs.md
dsh-biorxiv digest "protein language model" --limit 5
```

Each command prints one JSON envelope and exits `0` on success, `1` on a tool error, `2` on a usage error.

## MCP

Run the stdio server:

```bash
dsh-biorxiv-mcp
```

MCP client config example:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "biorxiv": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "--package", "dsh-biorxiv", "dsh-biorxiv-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

An npm package is not published yet. The `npx` form above works after publication; for a GitHub install, point the client at `node ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-biorxiv/dist/apps/mcp/main.js`.

The server exposes `biorxiv_search`, `biorxiv_paper`, `biorxiv_latest`, `biorxiv_export` and `biorxiv_digest` with the same JSON envelope.

## Configuration

Defaults live in the plugin schema; no config is required.

```json
{
  "cachePath": "~/.cache/dsh-biorxiv/cache.db",
  "cacheMode": "auto",
  "timeoutMs": 10000,
  "retries": 2,
  "maxBytes": 2000000,
  "userAgent": "dsh-biorxiv/0.1 (DeepSeek Harness plugin)",
  "summaryEnabled": false,
  "summaryModel": "deepseek-chat",
  "summaryBaseUrl": "https://api.deepseek.com",
  "summaryApiKeyEnv": "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
}
```

- `summaryEnabled`: default `false`. When true, `digest --summary` sends only public title/abstract to the configured model and labels output as machine-generated.
- The API key is read from the named environment variable; it is never written to config, cache or logs.
- CLI: `dsh-biorxiv digest "topic" --summary` opts in; it also enables the provider for that process.
- MCP: set `DSH_BIORXIV_SUMMARY=1` in the server environment, then call `biorxiv_digest` with `summary: true`.

- `cacheMode`: `auto` (SQLite when available, JSON fallback), `sqlite`, or `json`.
- Cache keys are SHA-256 hashes; query text is not written into the cache key.
- Delete the cache file to reset; it is disposable.

## Data sources and boundaries

- Search: Europe PMC REST (`SRC:PPR` + `PUBLISHER:"bioRxiv"`).
- Latest/version details: bioRxiv public API.
- Journal/retraction enrichment: Crossref and OpenAlex; failures are non-blocking.
- No full-text PDF download, no scraping behind 403/paywalls, no writes to source sites.
- Do not use for clinical, medical or investment decisions. Preprints are not peer-reviewed.

## Development

```bash
pnpm test
pnpm coverage
```

The coverage ratchet is enforced by `scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs`; line coverage must not fall below `.coverage-baseline.json`.

## License

MIT. See `LICENSE`. Privacy and data flow: see `PRIVACY.md`.

plugins.description: Deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF slots, comparable PS/PE, IRR — one unified schema.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-valuation-service

A deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. It reads a workpaper layout of `01.json` / `02.json` / `04.json`, computes six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots, comparable PS / PE and IRR, and writes one unified schema per project set.

It registers one agent tool, **`valuation_service`**. No AI inference, no invented numbers: anything missing is left blank and marked `missing` for a human or a downstream research step to fill.

## What it computes

| Block | Content |
|---|---|
| `ratios.historical` | profitability, solvency, efficiency, cash flow, valuation, growth |
| `ratios.forecast` | forecast-period profitability / growth / expense; BS- and CF-dependent ratios marked missing |
| `dcf` | full input slots (WACC, g, tax, EBIT, D&A, capex, ΔWC, net debt), outputs, missing list, hand-off anchors |
| `comparable` | PS and PE in parallel: trimmed mean, all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium |
| `irr` | target / conservative / optimistic, closed-vs-open judgement, deviation |
| `assumption_diff` | material assumptions vs assumptions computed from actuals, field by field |
| `pending` / `gate` | unresolved conflicts and C2–C7 gate status when the workpapers carry them |

## Input layout

```text
<base>/
├── 项目A/
│   └── json/
│       ├── 01.json   # financial.raw (BS/IS/CF) + financial.ratios
│       ├── 02.json   # assumptions.forecast + assumptions.comparables + assumptions.valuation
│       └── 04.json   # validation.irr_recompute
└── 项目B/
    └── json/...
```

`--base` defaults to `$DSH_VALUATION_BASE` or `./数据底表`. Projects are discovered dynamically: every directory with all three JSON files is included. No project list is hard-coded.

`01.json` may use either `raw = {bs, is, cf}` or report-title sections (e.g. `"一、资产负债表 · 资产"`); both are normalized.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/zirscard/dsh-valuation-service
```

Or from a local directory:

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-valuation-service
```

Restart DSH; a new session gets the `valuation_service` tool.

## Tool usage

```json
{
  "base": "/path/to/数据底表",
  "projects": "项目A,项目B",
  "write": true
}
```

- `base` (string, optional): workpaper root; relative paths resolve against the session working directory.
- `projects` (string or array, optional): restrict to these project directory names.
- `write` (boolean, optional, default `false`): write `<base>/valuations-service.json`.
- `out` (string, optional): override the output path.

The tool returns a per-project summary (DCF status and missing list, PS/PE status, IRR closed flag, assumption-diff count, gate) plus the output path.

## CLI usage

The Python entry point is usable without DSH (standard library only):

```bash
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --dry-run
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --projects 项目A
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --write
python3 core/valuation_service.py --base /path/to/数据底表 --write --json
```

`--json` prints one machine-readable summary object; `--write` writes the aggregate file; without `--write` it is a dry run.

## Unified schema

```json
{
  "schema": "m1.valuation-service/v2",
  "project_id": "...",
  "project_name": "...",
  "currency": "CNY",
  "method": "...",
  "financial_inputs": {"period": "...", "is": {}, "bs": {}, "cf": {}},
  "ratios": {"historical": {}, "forecast": {}},
  "dcf": {"status": "computed|partial|unavailable", "inputs": {}, "outputs": {}, "missing": [], "m3_handoff": {}},
  "comparable": {"ps": {}, "pe": {}},
  "irr": {"target": null, "conservative": null, "optimistic": null, "closed": false, "judge": "", "dev": null},
  "assumption_diff": [],
  "pending": [],
  "gate": {}
}
```

The aggregate file wraps records as `{"schema": "m1.valuation-service/aggregate/v2", "generated_at": "...", "base": "...", "projects": [...], "errors": [...]}`.

## Formulas

- Ratios: gross / operating / net margin, ROE, ROA; current / quick / cash ratio, debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets, interest coverage; asset / inventory / receivables turnover and days; OCF ratios; PS / PE / EV / EV-EBITDA; revenue and net-income growth.
- DCF: `FCFF = EBIT × (1 − t) + D&A − capex − ΔWC`; `TV = FCFF_last × (1 + g) / (WACC − g)`; `EV = Σ PV(FCFF) + PV(TV)`; `equity = EV − net debt`.
- Comparable: trimmed mean (10% each side when n ≥ 5), all-sample mean, 1-year mean, pre-money multiple, premium.
- IRR: `(exit value / invested capital) ^ (1 / years) − 1`.
- Assumption diff: material assumption vs module-computed actual, per field.

Ratio formulas are adapted from [anthropics/claude-cookbooks · analyzing-financial-statements/calculate_ratios.py](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-cookbooks/blob/main/skills/custom_skills/analyzing-financial-statements/calculate_ratios.py) (MIT), mapped onto Chinese three-statement labels.

## Adaptation layer

Data variants are handled in one place instead of per project:

| Variant | Function | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| raw layout (`{bs,is,cf}` vs report-title sections) | `_normalize_raw` | normalize by 资产负债表 / 利润表 / 现金流量表 keywords |
| units (thousand / ten-thousand / million CNY) | `_unit_for` | field-name suffix first, then `forecast.unit` |
| field-name variants | `_find_param` | keyword match + exclusion words |
| total vs line item (`资产总计` vs `流动资产合计`) | `_find_val` | totals require an exact match, no substring fallback |
| self-comparison in the comp set | `_included` | drop rows whose `treatment` says 自比 / 剔除 |
| no market PE multiple | `comparable.pe.status=assumption` | use the assumption range explicitly, never present it as a market multiple |

If a new variant is structural (layout / unit / naming), add it to the adapter. If it is a measurement convention, add it to the skill formulas. If data is missing, leave it blank and mark `missing`.

## DCF hand-off

Missing DCF inputs stay blank; `dcf.m3_handoff.anchors` lists what each one needs:

| Missing input | Anchor to fill |
|---|---|
| WACC | risk-free rate / beta / equity risk premium / capital structure |
| g | long-run GDP growth / industry terminal growth |
| capex | capex plan / construction in progress / capacity expansion |
| D&A | depreciation and amortization policy |
| ΔWC | receivables / inventory / payables turnover forecast |
| tax rate | effective tax rate |
| net debt | interest-bearing debt − cash |

## Test

```bash
python3 test/run_tests.py
```

The test builds a synthetic three-project workpaper set in a temporary directory (no client data), runs the service, and checks ratio values, DCF missing slots, comparable status, IRR and the written aggregate file.

## Boundaries

- No AI inference, no model calls, no network requests.
- No client data or project names are shipped in this repository.
- Missing inputs are marked, not fabricated.
- It does not replace a valuation model: it standardizes inputs and keeps the slots.

## License

MIT. Ratio formulas adapted from anthropics/claude-cookbooks (MIT); see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn sidebar entries into a compact icon row, with adjustable icon size and per-entry visibility.
plugins.readme_text:
# 侧栏图标并列（sidebar-icon-row）

DeepSeek Harness 插件的侧栏入口默认都是 42px 整行，所以「插件广场 / 远程控制 / 面板入口」会一条一行。
本插件把它们压成 36×36 的图标方块并排显示，并提供设置页。

- 面板入口（`sidebar.panellist`）与底部入口（`sidebar.footer.action`）统一处理；
- 「今日 / 余额」卡片仍独占一整行（沿用 cost-meter 自己的 `.cm-footer-stack`）；
- 每个入口只显示图标，常驻文字隐藏，悬停时在图标上方显示名称（纯 CSS `::after` + `aria-label`）；
- 侧栏收起成 56px 轨道时保持原样（图标竖排）；
- 底部新增一个「设置」齿轮入口，一键打开 DSH 设置页；
- 设置页里可调图标大小（16 / 18 / 20 / 24）、逐个开关入口、并调整图标先后顺序。

## 实现方式

- 只注入一个 `<style>` 节点，不修改任何宿主或其他插件的组件；
- 选择器用 `[data-slot="sidebar.footer.action"] > *` 与 `[class*="panelList"]` / `[class*="panelRow"]` 锚定，
  不使用 `_2H3hWW_` 这类带构建哈希的类名；
- 侧栏入口按渲染出来的名字（`aria-label` 优先）打上 `data-sir-key`，隐藏与排序都作用在这个属性上，
  关闭的入口直接 `display: none !important`（内联），所以不依赖选择器优先级；
- 排序通过给每个入口写 `order` 实现，不移动 DOM；
- 设置存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh.sidebar-icon-row.v1`），按浏览器各自保存。

## 设置页

`插件 → 已安装插件 → 侧栏图标并列`。设置区注册在 `plugins.bundle.config`（key 为包名），
在插件页描述下方、插件行上方渲染。

## 安装 / 卸载

```powershell
# 安装（当前 profile；源码就放在 profile 的 local-plugins 下，不依赖工作区）
dsh plugin install "E:\DeepseekHarness-data\data\profiles\desktop\local-plugins\sidebar-icon-row"
# 卸载
dsh plugin remove dsh-sidebar-icon-row
```

安装后刷新页面；新增 bundle 首次加载可能需要重启一次 `dsh web`。

## 回滚

在插件管理里关掉「侧栏图标并列」，或卸载本包：样式随 `<style>` 清理消失，
额外的「设置」图标随 `sidebar.footer.action` 的注册一并移除。

plugins.description: 策略声明 vs 实际执行：说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说
plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-policy [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) **说好不干的事干了没，干了的有没有说。** **关键词**：策略声明 · agent 权限 · 一致性核对 · 不出网 · 通配符放权 · 人工确认 · 过度代理 · 最小权限 --- ## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么 **是**：把项目的**策略声明**和**实际代码**摆在一起比 —— 策略文件（`policy.yml` / `agent.yml` / 权限配置）写了什么，代码里是不是真的那么干。 **不是**： - ❌ **不是运行时拦截** —— 不拦请求、不挡工具调用，只做静态比对 - ❌ **不是权限扫描器** —— 单看「权限是不是太宽」是 `dsh-agent-scope` 的活；这里只问「和声明对得上吗」 - ❌ **不是合规认证** —— 不判断你能不能过审 - ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只列事实：声明说 A，代码里是 B **一句话分界**： ``` agent-scope = 单看【权限本身】宽不宽（通配符、根目录、无限制出网） agent-policy = 看【声明】与【实现】是否一致 —— 说好不干的事干了没 ``` 同一个 `allow: "*"`，两边都可能提；但 agent-scope 说的是「这权限太宽」，agent-policy 说的是「你声明了允许一切，而你大概以为自己在声明白名单」。 --- ## 它查什么（5 条） | 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 | |---|---|---| | `POLICY-EGRESS-PROMISE` | 策略里写了「不出网」，同一项目里却有网络调用 | 🔴 | | `POLICY-CONFIRM-MISSING` | 代码里写着「需人工确认」，同一文件里却直接执行高风险动作 | 🔴 | | `POLICY-WILDCARD-ALLOW` | 策略里把权限写成通配符（`allow: "*"` / `tools: ["*"]` / `permissions: all`）| 🔴 | | `POLICY-DECL-EMPTY` | 策略声明里的工具清单是空的（`tools: []` / `tools: null`）| 🟡 | | `POLICY-NO-DECLARATION` | 有 agent 代码（调模型 / 工具）却找不到任何策略声明文件 | 🟡 | **每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行长什么样、依据是哪条标准。** ### 第 5 条为什么带 `when` `POLICY-NO-DECLARATION` 是「找不到」类判据，如果对所有项目都跑，一个只有 `index.js` 的普通小工具也会被报「没有策略声明」——那是误报。所以它只在项目里出现 agent 特征时才跑：`openai` / `anthropic` / `@deepseek-ai` / `tool_call` / `tool_use` / `AgentExecutor` 等。看到 `notApplicable` 里有它，说明这个项目没有 agent 代码，本来就不该跑。 --- ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-agent-policy ``` ## 用法 ```bash # 核对一个项目 dsh-agent-policy --root /path/to/your-agent # 看内置演示（一个「策略说不出网、代码里却在往外发」的假项目） dsh-agent-policy --demo # 列出规则与依据 dsh-agent-policy --list-rules # 出 HTML 报告 / 给 CI 用 dsh-agent-policy --root . --html dsh-agent-policy --root . --json ``` 退出码：有 high 命中 → `1`（可以挂 CI 卡口）。 --- ## 一个例子 `policy.yml` 里写着： ```yaml outbound: allow: false note: 本 agent 不出网，只访问内网工单库 ``` 而 `src/sync.js` 里： ```js const WEBHOOK = 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX'; export async function pushSummary(items) { const res = await fetch(WEBHOOK, { ... }); } ``` 报出来是这样： ``` POLICY-EGRESS-PROMISE src/sync.js:9 策略里写明了不准出网，同一个项目里却有网络调用 ``` **注意**：这不是说「出网就有罪」。是说到时候出事，大家会拿着这份 `policy.yml` 说「我们规定了不出网」——而实际上它在出。改代码或者改声明，让两边对上，是这份报告唯一的诉求。 --- ## 判据出处 - **OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 · LLM06 Excessive Agency** —— 智能体的能力应与其声明的边界一致；human-in-the-loop 控制 - **CIS Controls v8 · Control 6（Access Control Management）** —— 授权必须显式列出，最小权限 - **NIST AI RMF 1.0 · GOVERN 1.1 / 1.2、MANAGE 2.2、MAP 1.1** —— AI 系统的策略、责任与边界应明确且与执行一致 - **NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 · AC-6 Least Privilege** --- ## 双向验证 ```bash bash tests/run.sh ``` - 正例 `tests/fixtures/fail/demo-project/`：一个有策略文件、但代码处处和它拧着的客服 agent - 反例 `tests/fixtures/pass/clean-project/`：策略和实现逐条对得上的项目 - 空缺样本 `tests/fixtures/absent/minimal/`：有 agent 代码、完全没有策略文件 ## 许可 MIT --- ## # read-figure

Give a **text-only model** a pair of eyes — and a fixed contract for what those eyes must report.

`read-figure` is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that contributes exactly one tool, `read_figure`:

> Hand it the path of a figure on disk → it asks a vision model to transcribe that figure under a
> **fixed three-section protocol** → it returns the transcription as **plain text** in your context →
> you answer from it.

It does not solve the problem for you, and it should not. It does something narrower and much harder
to get right: **making "what is in this figure" clear enough to be quoted, challenged, and audited.**

---

## Why this exists

DSH can already send an *attached* image to a vision-capable model. What nobody had done is this:

- A text-only model (say `deepseek-v4-pro`) that is **given an image path** can neither see the
  image nor ask anyone who can to look at it.
- Even with a transcription, there is **no contract for its quality** — the reader cannot tell what
  was genuinely observed from what was guessed.
- Scanned exam figures routinely contain **stray black specks connected to nothing**. A human
  dismisses them as scanner noise at a glance. A text-only model cannot see the image, so it reads
  the speck as a particle, a hinge, or a label symbol — and **invents a mass that does not exist,
  invalidating the entire force analysis.**

That last point is why this plugin exists. One CPhO figure carries an isolated **3×3 px ink blob,
6 px in area**, in its upper-right corner; the problem statement itself warns
"treat it as scanner noise, not a particle." That warning is exactly what a model which cannot see
the image most needs, and most easily misses.

---

## What it produces

A fixed three-section handoff whose headings are reproduced verbatim:

```markdown
# 识图交接件 · 第 1 题

> 由 read-figure 自动生成，视觉模型 `deepseek-flash`，<timestamp>.
> 源图：`figures/1.jpg`（1536×2711px，183 KB）
> 分工：图像描述与复述由看图模型完成，物理解答由纯文本模型完成。**本文件不含任何解答。**

---

### 一、图的结构（逐项描述）
Connections → every component and its label → geometry and coordinate system. No vague wording.

### 二、复述
One paragraph of physical situation, then three lists: given / sought / conditions not in the figure.

### 三、⚠ 读图置信度声明
- **高置信**：…
- **不确定**：an isolated speck about 6×10 px at the upper right, touching no line,
  judged to be scanner noise. **If you are the text-only model reading this:
  do not introduce an extra particle or hinge because of it.**

---

## 给纯文本模型的执行说明（请一并遵守）
1. Do not fill in the figure from common sense …
2. Prefer a symbolic solution …
3. If a conclusion depends on an "uncertain" item, stop and say so …
4. Ask a follow-up list …
5. Close the answer inside the derivation sentence …
```

The protocol body is **a markdown file** (`prompts/figure-handoff.zh.md`), not strings buried in code.
Edit it directly, or point `promptFile` / `extraInstruction` at your own version —
**70% of this plugin's value is the protocol, not the few hundred lines of HTTP code.**

Three **real** outputs — verbatim, from actual runs on 2026-10-17, with only the local
absolute paths redacted — live in [`examples/`](examples/). They show both modes
(whole-figure handoff, and a targeted follow-up) and why `maxTokens` defaults to 32000:
the reasoning chain was **92.8%** of the completion on the scanned page.

---

## Install

### 1. Let the plugin manager do it (recommended — this is how the repo was verified)

Ask the agent to call `plugin_manager`, or use the equivalent CLI package operation:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  https://github.com/Amethyst-Leafs/dsh-read-figure
plugin_manager install_bundle  ./path/to/read-figure        # a local directory, for development
```

`install_bundle` runs `pnpm add` against the profile and appends the row declared in
`cordis.patch.yml` to the profile's bundle stack — **no hand-editing of profile files**.

**Restart dsh afterwards.** Host plugins mount when the process starts, so `read_figure` only
appears after a restart. (Measured on the desktop profile: the second install returned
`application: restart-required`, i.e. nothing failed at mount time. The first attempt returned
`failed` because this package's `Config` was not a Standard Schema yet.)

### 2. Manual mount

Add one row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: read-figure
  name: read-figure
  config:
    model: deepseek-flash
    apiKey: sk-…            # see "Credentials" below
```

### 3. Not installed at all (zero-install evaluation)

The CLI and the plugin share every code path, so you can judge the protocol before mounting anything:

```bash
node bin/read-figure.mjs --img figures/1.jpg --img figures/2.jpg --out out/handoff.md
```

---

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | any OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint |
| `model` | `deepseek-flash` | vision model name |
| `apiKey` | `''` | when empty, `READ_FIGURE_API_KEY` then `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| `maxTokens` | `32000` | already above the observed ceiling (~29k characters of reasoning at `effort: high` on a 3094×1526 scan); **lowering it re-creates the empty-answer bug** |
| `reasoningEffort` | `high` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | per-request timeout |
| `promptFile` | `''` | empty uses the packaged `prompts/figure-handoff.zh.md` |
| `extraInstruction` | `''` | appended after the protocol, for every call in the session |
| `handoffDir` | `''` | when set, `outPath` must resolve inside it |
| `writeHandoff` | `false` | reserved: write by default |

### Credentials

A **running** DSH cannot see a shell variable exported after it started.
If an environment variable does not take effect, write `apiKey` directly into the `cordis.patch.yml` row.

---

## Using the tool

### First pass

```json
{ "imagePath": "output/…/figures/1.jpg", "label": "第 1 题" }
```

Several figures: `{"imagePaths": ["figures/1.jpg", "figures/2.jpg"], "label": "第 1、2 题"}`

### Directed follow-up

When the handoff lists an uncertainty, **do not re-run the whole transcription** — ask about it:

```json
{
  "imagePath": "figures/1.jpg",
  "question": "The longest rope hanging from B's left side — does it end at m₂ or m₃? What difference would each reading make?"
}
```

A follow-up answers that one question only, and requires the vision model to cite **position and
observed shape/pixel magnitude**. If both readings are defensible it says so, and states what
physical picture each one implies.

---

## Design notes

- **Transcribe only, never reason.** The first hard rule of the protocol is "absolutely no problem
  solving." The moment the vision model starts computing, the handoff stops being an auditable
  observation record and degrades into an answer of unknown quality that the reader can neither
  verify nor challenge.
- **Uncertainty must be listed explicitly, with a guard sentence.** Reporting "there is a speck here"
  is itself **dangerous**: without "it is noise, do not add a particle for it," a text-only model will
  take it as real. Hence the protocol demands all five parts: position, pixel size, judgement,
  reasoning, and the guard sentence.
- **False positives are more dangerous than misses.** This comes from measurement: a mechanical
  speck detector's first run reported 7 candidates on one figure, all at `x≈1` or `y≈1` — cropped
  black edges of the scan. Injected as-is, the model would believe the problem has 7 extra labels.
  **Any mechanical evidence must pass a false-positive suppression rule before an LLM sees it.**
- **Thresholds do not scale with resolution.** It is tempting to scale the pixel threshold by image
  size. Don't. `figures/2.jpg`'s stray blob (area 1139) sits squarely *between* the letterforms
  (`figures/1.jpg`'s "A" is 871, `figures/2.jpg`'s "M" is 6756) — **no area cut separates blob from
  letter.** What separates them is *small and solid*: the letters are either ≥ 70 px in one dimension
  or hollow (fill ratio ≤ 0.47). A regression test pins this: a ceiling tuned to 1.jpg (area ≤ 600)
  drops 2.jpg's blob entirely.
- **Sizes come from the file header.** "How big is that speck" is a citable fact in the h

plugins.description: DSH Desktop 冷启动开机动画插件 · Arknights 风格 HUD boot sequence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-cold-boot)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cold-boot · DSH 开机动画

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 的界面加一段 44 秒的冷启动演出：黑底、等宽字、扫描线与 glitch，
六场戏、四句英文人声，音效全部用 Web Audio 现场合成。纯 DOM + CSS，**零运行时依赖**，
装完下次打开就播（点画面或按任意键跳过）。

> 非官方同人作品，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。产品名与鲸鱼标识归其权利人所有 —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

![开场](docs/img/1-cold-boot.png)
![标识与光扫](docs/img/2-whale-sweep.png)
![三栏全貌](docs/img/3-overview.png)
![授权通过](docs/img/4-authorization.png)
![定格名牌](docs/img/5-final-plate.png)

## 安装

| 方式 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 应用内插件市场 | 在市场里搜 **dsh-cold-boot**，一键装 |
| npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cold-boot`（预构建，免构建授权） |
| 本地 tgz | 下载 `dsh-cold-boot-<版本>.tgz` → DSH 的插件页「从本地文件安装」 |
| 源码 | `git clone` 后 `npm run build`（`prepare` 钩子也会自动构建），再从目录安装 |

关掉 / 只播一次（浏览器控制台）：

```js
localStorage['dsh-cold-boot'] = 'off'    // 永不播
localStorage['dsh-cold-boot'] = 'once'   // 每个标签页只播一次；删掉这个键就恢复每次开机都播
```

装完在 profile 的 `package.json` 里会多一条 `dsh.profile.bundles` 记录
（本机是 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web`，`patchReload: live`，不用重启）。
想关掉就把它从 bundles 里去掉，或者直接卸载。

## 看效果（不装插件也能看）

```bash
npm run standalone     # → preview-standalone.html（1.7MB 单文件，引擎 + 四句人声全内联）
```

双击打开即可，不需要服务器、不依赖相对路径（可以随便拷给别人）。

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| ▶ 从头播 | 整段 **44 秒**跑一遍（点画面、按任意键都能跳过） |
| ⏭ 跳过 | 直接走收尾流程 |
| 时长 32s / 44s / 56s | 整段压缩或拉长，人声音高不变、语速跟着缩放 |
| 🔊 / 🔇 | 开关音效与人声（浏览器拦自动播放，点一下才有声音） |
| ① ~ ⑥ | 定格在六场戏的任意一场 |

`npm run frames 16000 34000` 会生成 `dev/frame-<ms>.html` 定格页 —— 改完时间轴先拿它逐帧核对。

## 六场戏（基准 44000ms）

| 时刻 | 场 | 画面 |
|---|---|---|
| 0–7.6s | ① | 冷启动字幕（COLD BOOT / 冷启动序列 · 逐项自检 / SEQUENCE 00）+ 日志开始打字 |
| 2.6s / 12.8s | ①③ | 人声 1「Uplink established. Terminal boot sequence initiated.」；人声 2「Self-check complete…」 |
| 8.0–12.8s | ② | 标识逐笔描线（六边形线框 → 鲸鱼 → 一道光扫掠过 → DSH 字标落下）、档案栏、幽灵编号 07 |
| 13.4–26.2s | ③ | 三栏全貌 + 标题 DEEPSEEK HARNESS + 副标题 + 代号 + 日志 18 行 + 进度条与六盏步骤灯 |
| 23.6s | ③ | 人声 3「Permission proxy armed. Session handover standing by.」 |
| 26.2–30.6s | ④ | 权限校验面板：六条 scope 逐行落（workspace-write OK / 9 industrial modules ON / MCP ONLINE / modbus write ASK / credentials LOCKED / session OK），右侧百分比推到 100 |
| 31.6–40.2s | ⑤ | 授权通过：三个同心环 + AUTHORIZATION GRANTED + 一道红细线（全片唯一的红）；33.8s 人声 4「System ready. Welcome back, Engineer.」 |
| 41.2s | ⑥ | 白闪 → 切三栏 → 41.8–44s 干净名牌停 2.2 秒 → 0.9 秒淡出，露出 DSH 界面 |

**场景层之间是先出后进**（前一块淡完才开始下一块），不会出现两块面板同时半透明。

## 里面有多少「真的是 DSH」

不是套壳文案，几个读数是对着本机实际安装抄的：

* **鲸鱼**＝ DSH 桌面端 `resources\icon.png` 里那只抠出来的，不是网上随手找的图；
* **v0.11.1**＝ `DSH Desktop.exe` 的 ProductVersion；**30 loaded**＝ profile 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 的条数；
* 场① 第二行 `81 SKILLS · 30 PLUGINS · 9 MCP · $ dsh doctor`、场③ 的 `DSH desktop v0.11.1 · web profile`
  与 `dsh doctor` 日志行，都可以按你自己的机器改（改 `DEFAULT_LOG` / `TEXT` 常量即可）；
* 三条读数（CONTEXT / PERMISSION / TOOLS）跟着动画时间走，不是写死的静态条。

## 人声与音效

* 四句人声：**英文**，Windows SAPI（Zira，Rate −4 ≈ 比常速慢 45%）+ `scripts/voice-fx.py -ann`
  提亮到参考素材的频谱（F0 190Hz / 质心 1063Hz）。文件 `audio/en/L1..L4-zira-rm4-ann.wav`，
  实测 7.16 / 7.74 / 7.34 / 6.63 秒。**每句时长写进了 `DEFAULT_VOICE[].dur`** ——
  漏写会退回 3900ms 的假设值，就是之前「两个声音」的根因（第三句实际说到 24.87s，压上第四句）。
* 音效（`createSound()`）：低频底噪、终端 blip、glitch 噪声、白闪、收尾 chime 全部用 Web Audio
  现场合成，不带素材；音量比人声低 12~20dB，说话时自动 duck。
* 语音时刻表 2.6 / 12.8 / 23.6 / 33.8s，末句 40.4s 收，白闪 41.2s —— 每句都留 ≥800ms 余量。

## 插件形态

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边（1.7MB）：引擎 + CSS + 四句人声（base64 WAV）全内联，`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` 外壳 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半边（<1KB）：空实现 + 名字与版本，只为让 cordis 认得这个 bundle |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 往 profile 里插一条 `#dsh-cold-boot` |
| `icon.png` | 512×512 插件图标（同一只鲸鱼 + HUD 细框） |

宿主侧不碰任何东西（不读文件、不发请求、不注册工具），所以**权限上只要 workspace-write 就够**。
前端只用到 DSH 客户端自带的 `ctx`/`React`/`host.call`/`styles.insert`，没有额外 peer 依赖。

## 文件

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `src/boot-animation.js` | **引擎**（唯一事实来源）：时间轴 `T`、日志/步骤/人声文案、CSS、`play()` |
| `src/client-glue.js` | 插件外壳：把引擎挂上 `window.DSHBootAnimation`，给插件半边的调用面 |
| `src/host-half.js` | 宿主半边源码（空实现） |
| `audio/en/L1..L4-zira-rm4-ann.wav` | 四句英文人声（16bit 单声道 22.05kHz） |
| `scripts/build-plugin.mjs` | 打 `lib/`（内联音频、查语法、查同步）；`--check` 只校验 |
| `scripts/build-standalone.mjs` | 打 `preview-standalone.html`（引擎 + 人声 data URI 内联） |
| `scripts/build-frames.mjs <ms...>` | 生成 `dev/frame-<ms>.html` 定格页（自检用） |
| `scripts/make-icon.py` | 用抠好的鲸鱼遮罩画插件图标 |
| `scripts/voice-fx.py` · `scripts/voice-analyze.py` | 人声染色 / 量化（numpy） |
| `docs/img/` | README 里那五张图 |

## 引擎 API

```js
var handle = DSHBootAnimation.play({
  duration: 44000,          // 整段时长；相位按比例缩放
  sound: true, volume: 0.55,
  soundBase: '', voiceBase: '',   // 装成插件后指向只读资源路由
  voice: [{ src, dur, text, meta }],
  log: [...], steps: [...], rail: [...],
  skipOnClick: true, oncePerSession: false, seek: null, onDone: fn
});
handle.finish();   // 跳过
handle.destroy();  // 立刻摘掉遮罩
```

改时间轴只需要动：相位表 `T`、步骤灯时刻 `STEP_AT`、日志 `DEFAULT_LOG`、人声 `DEFAULT_VOICE`
（CSS 里的 `--t-*` 变量与 `T` 一一对应，两处要一起改）。

## 已验证 / 已知

* 六场戏 + 结尾定格逐帧截图核对（1280×800 与 512×900 两种窗口）；量尺（`getBoundingClientRect`）
  确认窄窗下标题单行不溢出、档案栏一行一条、日志底部不被步骤灯压住。
* 实跑收尾、点击跳过、`destroy()` 三条路径都实测会摘掉 `#dsh-boot-animation` 与 `<style>`，不会留黑屏。
* 打包体积：`lib/client.js` 1.7MB → tgz **830KB**（四句人声内联占 1.2MB）。
* 踩过的坑：`animation` 是简写，**收尾的 `dsb-keep` 必须写在各元素自己的规则里**（分组规则会覆盖入场动画）；
  淡出动画只能 `forwards`，配 `both` 会在延迟到点前就按不透明显示；`inset:auto` 会把前面的
  `left/top` 一起重置，居中元素要把它写在 `left/top` **之前**。

## 许可

MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。人声由 Windows SAPI 合成、音效现场生成，仓库里不含任何第三方素材。

| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![FigCraft Use — interface design in your agent workspace](assets/official-logo.png)

> Design, restructure and hand off an interface inside your agent host, with the editable FigCraft document and its tokens kept as the source of truth.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/figcraft-plugin/releases)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-11-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20tools-26-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`figcraft` turns a page requirement into an editable interface document and carries it through design system, responsive layout, prototype and handoff. The plugin bundles a source-built FigCraft Web with same-session MCP automation and workspace file operations; it does not re-implement the design engine or claim pixel fidelity it has not checked.

| Property | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Plugin ID | `figcraft` |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.3` |
| Status | Development preview; all-host acceptance still open |
| Editor runtime | Node.js 24, started from `ui/bootstrap.mjs` |
| Editor baseline | FigCraft `v0.6.0` fixed source plus this plugin's automation build |
| Optional CLI | `figcraft-cli`, used by recipe scripts as `--cli` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 24 on `PATH`; the bundled stdio MCP server runs on it.
- Network access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive; a complete release ZIP already contains it, so no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are required.
- `python3` on `PATH` only if you run the optional recipe scripts that ship with four skills.
- `figcraft-cli` only if a recipe should drive the native CLI; the plugin does not install it.
- A host that supports plugins or stdio MCP. Embedded panels additionally require MCP Apps or a built-in browser.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add figcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

Restart the host, open a new task, and ask FigCraft to open the editor for your workspace.

### Other host manifests

| Host | Manifest | Path base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Agent Plugins 1.0.0 | `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` | plugin root relative to `cwd` |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` |

Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`), DeepSeek Harness (`dsh/`) and the WorkBuddy example (`hosts/workbuddy/mcp.json`) are also present. In a development checkout you must build the editor assets first; cloning the source is not an installed runtime.

## Quick start

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Install plugin] --> B[Restart and open a task]
    B --> C[open_editor]
    C --> D{editor_status ready?}
    D -->|No| C
    D -->|Yes| E[create_node / set_properties]
    E --> F[inspect_document / get_node]
    F --> G[save_file]
    G --> H[export]
```

1. Open the editor with an explicit `workspace` argument.
2. Build the first frame with `create_node`, then style it with `set_properties`; complex structures go through `run_command` or `batch`.
3. Read `inspect_document` for structure and `screenshot` for the actual image.
4. Save with `save_file`, reopen with `open_file`, and confirm the layers are still editable.
5. Export for handoff only after the reopened document matches what you approved.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Low-fidelity wireframe | `figcraft-wireframe` | Structured frames and blocks, no invented content |
| Design system with variables | `figcraft-design-system` | Component library, states, colour and text variables |
| Light and dark token card | `figcraft-light-dark-token-card` | Semantic aliases with CSS or JSON delivery |
| Responsive layout | `figcraft-responsive-layout` | Auto-layout frames with wrap and overflow handled |
| Clickable prototype | `figcraft-prototype-flow` | Pages connected with entry, back and overlay states |
| Import an existing Figma file | `figcraft-import-fig` | Imported nodes plus a loss report for fonts and images |
| Editable chart | `figcraft-signed-bar-chart` | Positive, negative and zero values as editable bars |
| Swappable icon button | `figcraft-swappable-icon-button` | Instance swap and boolean visibility, text kept separate |
| Developer handoff | `figcraft-dev-handoff` | Annotations, measurements, CSS or React references |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| `figcraft-editor` | Open FigCraft in the host, check same-session MCP, diagnose workspace save |
| `figcraft-wireframe` | Turn a page requirement into a low-fidelity wireframe or first interface |
| `figcraft-responsive-layout` | Mobile, tablet and desktop adaptation, auto layout, wrap and overflow |
| `figcraft-design-system` | Component library, button states, colour and text variables, light/dark themes |
| `figcraft-prototype-flow` | Connect pages into a clickable prototype with entry and overlay states |
| `figcraft-import-fig` | Import Figma `.fig`, REST file JSON or SVG and report fidelity loss |
| `figcraft-dev-handoff` | Editable UI, annotations, assets and CSS or React references |
| `figcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Recipes for login, plan card, metric component, navigation, container, dialog, empty and error states |
| `figcraft-light-dark-token-card` | Light/dark theme and semantic colour tokens with real command bindings |
| `figcraft-swappable-icon-button` | Icon swap plus hideable icon, with return-ID binding and re-check |
| `figcraft-signed-bar-chart` | Editable bars including positive, negative and zero values |

Skills come from the independent `figcraft-skills` source and are pinned by `scenario-candidates.json` with per-skill SHA-256 digests.

## MCP tools

One bundled server, `figcraft-editor`, speaking **stdio**. The local HTTP listener only serves the editor page and its same-session bridge. The catalogue exposes 26 tools: 21 agent-callable tools and 5 `_editor_*` bridge tools the panel uses internally.

| Family | Tools | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Session | `open_editor`, `open_browser_editor`, `editor_status` | Open the editor and confirm that it attached |
| Discovery | `list_commands` | List live command IDs, parameters and enabled state |
| Command gateway | `run_command`, `batch` | Run one command, or an ordered batch |
| Authoring | `create_node`, `set_properties` | Create nodes and set their properties, returning IDs |
| Inspection | `inspect_document`, `get_node`, `inspect_ui` | Document tree, one node, and interface state |
| Selection and input | `select`, `pointer`, `key`, `type_text` | Select objects and drive the same input paths as a user |
| Files | `open_file`, `save_file`, `export`, `screenshot` | Open, save, export and capture the canvas |
| History | `undo`, `redo` | Step back and forward one change |

## Configuration

| Setting | Where | Effect |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `workspace` argument | `open_editor` / `open_browser_editor` | Binds the task folder; paths outside it are refused |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_UPDATE=off` | stdio MCP `env` | Use the bundled editor only; no download attempt |
| `CRAFT_EDITOR_CACHE_DIR` | Environment | Absolute directory for verified editor archives |
| `CRAFT_WORK

# dsh-deepseek-provider

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：Web GUI 底部余额 pill（`conversation.composer.dock`），仅当前会话选用 DeepSeek 模型时显示，摘要展示主币种总额（优先 CNY），点击开面板看各币种总额 / 赠金 / 充值与账户可用性。数据取自 DeepSeek 开放平台 `GET /user/balance`。

## 使用方法

1. 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add youmu129/dsh-deepseek-provider`，重启 `dsh web`（GitHub 简写规格，安装时自动装依赖；lib 构建产物已入库，无需本地构建）；
2. 凭证：默认引用 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`（与内置 DeepSeek 路由同一把钥匙，零新增配置）；未配置时 pill 显示「未配置」；

凭证只经 DSH 凭证机制或环境变量存放，不入库、不写入日志与文档。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

English · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Plugins for **[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)** (DeepSeek Harness) — and the notes I wish I had
when writing the first one.

| Plugin | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`plugins/deepseek-web-chat`](plugins/deepseek-web-chat) | A chat.deepseek.com panel in DSH's right sidebar: ask the web chat from inside the app, with workspace files or a DSH conversation attached as context. Uses your own account, no API key. |

![sign-in page](plugins/deepseek-web-chat/docs/gate-zh.png)

## Why a repo for plugins

A DSH plugin is small but not obvious: it has a **Host half** (a Cordis plugin that owns services,
HTTP routes and credentials) and a **browser half** (a bundle the DSH web UI registers as a slot),
plus a bundle patch so the loader knows the Host row. This repo keeps those pieces in one place with a
repeatable layout, tests and a reload workflow:

```
dsh-plugins/
├─ README.md / README.zh-CN.md      this page
├─ LICENSE                          MIT
├─ docs/
│  ├─ writing-a-plugin.md           how the two halves fit together
│  └─ writing-a-plugin.zh-CN.md
└─ plugins/
   └─ deepseek-web-chat/
      ├─ package.json               dsh.bundle / dsh.client declarations
      ├─ cordis.patch.yml           bundle layer: insert the Host row
      ├─ lib/                       Host (index.js, host/*) + client bundle (client.js) + web UI
      ├─ scripts/                   self-tests, smoke tests, preview server
      └─ docs/                      bilingual user guide and screenshots
```

## Quick start

Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH and paste this one line:

```
github:vector-c-li/dsh-plugins#path:/plugins/deepseek-web-chat
```

DSH installs it with pnpm and enables it as a bundle; refresh the page (restart once if the sidebar
tab is missing) and open **DeepSeek Chat** from the `+` menu. The proof-of-work module is fetched on
first use, so there is nothing else to download.

Prefer a local checkout (for development)? `git clone` the repo and follow
[`plugins/deepseek-web-chat/README.md`](plugins/deepseek-web-chat/README.md#install) (English) or
[`README.zh-CN.md`](plugins/deepseek-web-chat/README.zh-CN.md#安装) (中文).

## Reading order

1. [`docs/writing-a-plugin.md`](docs/writing-a-plugin.md) — Host half, browser half, bundle patch,
   the module-cache trick that makes hot reload work, and the testing pyramid this repo follows.
2. [`plugins/deepseek-web-chat`](plugins/deepseek-web-chat) — a complete worked example: credentials,
   an HTTP route, an SSE stream, a WebAssembly dependency, drag-and-drop context, bilingual UI.
3. [`plugins/deepseek-web-chat/docs/guide.en.md`](plugins/deepseek-web-chat/docs/guide.en.md) — the
   user-facing guide.

## Conventions

- **One plugin per directory** under `plugins/`, named after its package (`dsh-<name>`).
- **Bilingual docs**: every human-facing document exists as `X.md` (English) and `X.zh-CN.md`
  (中文), each starting with a language switcher line.
- **No personal data in git**: no absolute home paths, no account identifiers, no tokens, no
  screenshots of a real account. See the checklist in the writing guide.
- **Downloaded assets stay out**: vendor blobs (like the proof-of-work module) are fetched by a
  script and listed in `.gitignore`.

## Privacy

These plugins run inside your DSH and talk to third-party services with **your** credentials. Nothing
is collected by this repository: there is no telemetry, and no server of mine is involved. Each
plugin's README has a *Privacy* section that states exactly what it stores and what leaves your
machine — read it before attaching files or conversations as context.

## Licence

[MIT](LICENSE) for the code here. Third-party material (DeepSeek's proof-of-work module, the
chat.deepseek.com API, trademarks) is covered by [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md).

# 🌐 dsh-community ### DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 官方与开源生态「插件与 Skill 双生态市场」 [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Minglink/dsh-community?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-community/stargazers) [![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Minglink/dsh-community?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Desktop%20%7C%20Web-blue?style=flat-square)](https://deepseek.stream) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-v0.2.x%2B-purple?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![Cordis Core](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cordis-v4.x-emerald?style=flat-square)](https://cordis.moe) **简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)
--- ## 📖 项目全景与定位 (Overview) `dsh-community` 是专为 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 深度定制的官方与开源生态资产扩展中心。本插件深度整合 Cordis 微内核设计哲学，为 DSH 注入了极高审美、丝滑交互的**「Cordis 插件（Plugins）」与「智能体技能（Agent Skills）」双生态统一应用市场**。 无论是运行在 **DSH 官方桌面端 (Electron)**，还是在 **纯 Web 端 / 远端服务器 (Headless / Docker)**，`dsh-community` 均能自动识别当前宿主环境，提供秒级检索、在线 SOP 规范解析、一键安装装配、沙箱验证与运行诊断的全生命周期闭环。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性矩阵 (Key Features) ### 1. 🔌 双生态并行中心 (Dual-Ecosystem Architecture) * **Cordis 插件市场（Plugins Market）**： * **海量收录**：覆盖深度推理强化、视觉多模态适配、Agent 工作流调度、持久化终端、系统桌宠与个性化 UI 增强等 400+ 款在册插件。 * **容器级生命周期管控**：支持插件的一键安装、试运行校验（Trial）、在线热重载（HMR）、启用/禁用状态切换与事务级原子化卸载。 * **配置自愈机制**：自动维护 `cordis.patch.yml` 与环境依赖项，无需手动修改底层 YAML 配置文件。 * **智能体技能市场（Skills Market）**： * **SOP 资产标准化**：收录符合 Anthropic / DSH 现代 Agent 规范的精选技能库（Prompt / SOP / Action Rules）。 * **零 Token 冗余开销**：技能以模块化方式落地于宿主 `~/.dsh/skills/{id}/` 目录，对话中按需调度，杜绝全局上下文污染与无谓的上下文 Token 浪费。 * **即开即览**：支持在市场内直接在线预览完整的 `SKILL.md` 正文，直观查阅触发场景（`whenToUse`）与前置依赖工具清单（`requiredTools`）。 ### 2. 🏷️ 深度适配官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件标签与标准 (Official Standards) * **认证标签（Official Badge）**： * 自动深度比对官方插件元数据库，针对官方自研旗舰（如 `dsh-better-sidebar`、`dsh-infinite-gen`、`dsh-plugin-agent-workflow`、`modlens` 等）以及高星官方金牌扩展，在列表中自动高亮展示 `官方` 专属认证标签。 * **多维场景与标签检索矩阵**： * **主分类维度**：开发底座（`dev`）、效率工具（`tools`）、多模态与视觉（`models`）、提示词与推理（`prompt`）、工作流自动化（`workflow`）、视觉外观（`ui`）。 * **自由场景标签（Scene Tags）**：支持快捷筛选 `#官方`、`#视觉`、`#终端`、`#RAG` 等场景标签，点击标签即可秒级聚合。 * **生态多维排序**：热门总榜、⭐ 必装精选、飙升榜、最新发布、累计下载、星标榜与用户真实评分榜。 * **严格遵循官方 Manifest 契约**： * 产物全面遵循 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-package-manifest` 契约，自动注入 `"dsh": { "manifestVersion": 1 }`，向下兼容标准 Cordis Loader 容器。 ### 3. 🌉 Universal Bridge 全平台双模自适应架构 * **DSH 桌面端环境 (Desktop Native Mode)**： * 对接底层 Electron IPC 与 Windows 注册表协议，支持通过浏览器或中台点击一键直接唤醒桌面客户端完成静默装配。 * **可视化任务诊断控制台**： * **任务执行日志面板 (`CommunityTaskLogPanel`)**：实时滚屏查看下载速率、解压进度、Junction 虚拟软链状态与 pnpm 构建事务日志。 * **运行时诊断面板 (`CommunityRuntimeLogPanel`)**：实时捕获宿主渲染层异常与崩溃堆栈，支持一键脱敏导出与排障。 * **标准 Web / 远程环境 (Universal Web Fallback)**： * 在无 Electron 底座的 Web 模式下无缝降级，直接连通深流社区云端中枢（`https://deepseek.stream/api`）。 * 提供完全一致的浏览、搜索、分页与 SOP 在线预览体验，并支持一键复制外部拉起协议命令。 ### 4. 🎨 极致的原生视觉与交互设计 * 采用 DSH 官方底层 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 组件库构建，视觉风格与深流宿主浑然一体。 * 原生暗黑科技极简风格，流畅动效与状态指示灯。 * 完备的国际化本地化字典（`community-locales.ts`），中英双语无缝切换。 * 原生注册全局侧边栏入口与快捷键呼出（`CmdOrCtrl+M`）。 --- ## 🏗️ 架构拓扑 (Architecture Topology) ```text ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ DeepSeek Stream 云端生态中枢 │ │ (https://deepseek.stream) │ └──────────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘ │ HTTP API / dsh:// 外部协议 ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ dsh-community 客户端插件 │ │ │ │ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Universal Bridge 桥接层 │ │ │ │ (自动环境探测: window.dshDesktop ? DesktopMode : WebMode) │ │ │ └──────────────────┬──────────────────────────┬──────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ [Desktop 模式: Electron IPC] [Web 降级模式: Fetch API] │ │ │ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ │ │ ┌──────────────────────────────────┐ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ 本地宿主进程 (Host IPC) │ │ 深流云端 OpenAPI 直连 │ │ │ │ - dsh:// 协议解析器 │ │ - 插件/Skill 大厅检索 │ │ │ │ - aiInspect 安全预检 │ │ - 在线 SOP Markdown 解析│ │ │ │ - Junction 软链与 Patch 事务自愈 │ │ - 协议调用指令一键复制 │ │ │ │ - 实时任务诊断 (TaskLog) │ └─────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ - 运行状态诊断 (RuntimeLog) │ │ │ └──────────────────┬───────────────┘ │ │ ▼ │ │ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ DeepSeek Harness 核心容器 │ │ │ │ ~/.dsh/plugins/ & ~/.dsh/skills/ & cordis.yml │ │ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🚀 安装与装配指引 (Installation & Setup) ### 方式一：DSH Profile 配置文件集成（推荐） 1. **获取插件代码**： 将本仓库直接克隆至你的 DSH 用户插件目录： ```bash git clone https://github.com/Minglink/dsh-community.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-community ``` 2. **在 Cordis 配置中注入挂载**： 在当前运行的 Profile 配置文件（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 或 `cordis.yml`）中添加插入项： ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-community name: dsh-community ``` 3. **重启并体验**： 启动或重启 DeepSeek Harness，左侧导航栏将出现 **「插件与 Skill 市场」** 入口图标（支持全局快捷键 `CmdOrCtrl+M`）。 --- ### 方式二：外部 `dsh://` 协议一键静默安装 通过深流官方中台（[deepseek.stream/software](https://deepseek.stream/software)）点击「🚀 一键唤醒桌面端安装」，或在系统运行终端中执行： ```powershell # Windows 环境协议模拟执行 Start-Process "dsh://plugin/install?id=dsh-community&name=深流社区插件市场&downloadUrl=https://deepseek.stream/api/plugins/download?id=dsh-community" ``` 桌面端守护进程捕获协议后，将自动完成依赖下载、目录挂载与热重载。 --- ## 📡 `dsh://` 协议调用规范 (Protocol Specification) 桌面端通过注册 Windows 系统 URL Protocol `dsh://` 实现跨应用交互，支持如下标准调用范式： ### 1. 插件安装协议 (`dsh://plugin/install`) ```text dsh://plugin/install?id={id}&name={name}&version={version}&repo={repo}&downloadUrl={downloadUrl}&permissions={permissions} ``` * **参数说明**： * `id` *(必填)*: 插件全英文唯一标识符（如 `dsh-community`、`dsh-infinite-gen-3`）。 * `name` *(必填)*: 插件友好中文显示名称（URL 编码）。 * `version` *(可选)*: 版本号约束（如 `0.2.1` 或 `latest`）。 * `downloadUrl` *(可选)*: 预编译安装包 ZIP 直链。 * `repo` *(可选)*: GitHub 源码仓库标识（如 `Minglink/dsh-community`）。 ### 2. 技能安装协议 (`dsh://skill/install`) ```text dsh://skill/install?id={id}&name={name}&version={version}&downloadUrl={downloadUrl} ``` * **落地动作**： * 下载并解压技能包至 `~/.dsh/skills/{id}/` 目录； * 自动验证包含核心 `SKILL.md` SOP 规范正文； * 即时挂载至 Agent 思考上下文，无需重启宿主。 --- ## 🛠️ 二次开发与构建 (Development & Build) 本工程采用现代轻量化单文件打包架构，源码基于 TypeScript 与 React 18，无需繁冗笨重的脚手架。 ### 目录结构导航 ```text dsh-community/ ├── cordis.patch.yml # Cordis 容器自动装配配置 ├── index.js # Cordis Host 插件生命周期入口 ├── package.json # 模块元数据与导向配置 ├── build.js # 基于 tsdown & lightningcss 的构建引擎 ├── tsconfig.client.json # 客户端 TypeScript 严格配置 ├── client/ # 预构建前端 Bundle（供 DSH __ModuleLoader__ 直接加载） │ ├── client.js # 编译后生产环境单文件 Bundle (带 SourceMap) │ └── client.js.map └── src/ └── client/ # 完整前端源码 ├── index.ts # 客户端注入点（含 Desktop/Web 双模式桥接） ├── CommunitySection.tsx # 市场主面板（双 Tab、SOP 预览、分类与检索） ├── CommunityRuntimeLogPanel.tsx # 运行时诊断日志组件 ├── CommunityTaskLogPanel.tsx # 任务执行日志组件 ├── community-locales.ts # 完整中英双语国际化字典 ├── community-types.ts # TypeScript 强类型契约定义 └── Community.module.css # 暗黑极简设计规范样式 ``` ### 构建指令 ```bash # 1. 安装开发构建依赖 (若独立编译) npm install # 2. 执行生产级单文件极速构建 (输出 client/client.

plugins.readme_text:
# 收纳间 dsh-closet

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的临时脚本与日志管理器：**按工作区登记脚本、只读扫描遗留物、一键清运进可还原回收站。**

中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

DSH 干活时会留下大量临时脚本和日志 —— `fix-xxx.ps1`、`upgrade-xxx.ps1`、`restart-dsh.log`、`*.bak`…… 事后没人记得哪个还能用、哪个已经过期、哪个可以删。

收纳间就是给这些产物准备的**一个抽屉**：放进去的都记在册上，没放的会被扫出来问你，清掉的先进回收站，随时能捞回来。

## 三条铁律

1. **跟着工作区走**：数据存在 `<工作区>/.dsh-fix/`，换工作区就是换一个抽屉，绝不往用户目录乱写。
2. **扫描永不删除**：`closet_scan` 只列清单、给理由，一个字节都不动。
3. **清理只做移动**：`closet_clean` 把文件移进 `.dsh-fix/trash/<批次>/`，附带 `manifest.json` 记录原路径，随时可还原；真正的删除只有「过期清理」一处入口，默认 30 天后才允许，且默认只做预演。

## 目录结构

```
<工作区>/
└── .dsh-fix/                    # 收纳间（dataDir 可配置）
    ├── registry.json            # 登记册：路径/语言/用途/状态/运行次数
    ├── logs/<脚本名>/            # 每次执行的完整输出，按时间戳分文件
    │   └── 20261018-165530.log
    └── trash/<批次>/             # 回收站
        ├── manifest.json        # 每个文件的原路径与体积
        └── <搬进来的文件>
```

## 工具

装上插件后，AI 可以直接调用 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 | 会改文件吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `closet_register` | 登记一个脚本：路径、用途、语言、状态（active/done/obsolete） | 只写登记册 |
| `closet_list` | 列出登记册，并标注「文件还在不在」 | 否 |
| `closet_scan` | 扫描工作区，列出疑似遗留物及判定理由；`skipTracked: true` 可完全不显示已被 git 跟踪的文件 | **否** |
| `closet_run` | 按语言执行登记过的脚本，输出写进日志 | 只写日志 |
| `closet_clean` | 把指定文件移进回收站（可还原）；**已被 git 跟踪的文件会被拒收**，确需清运要带 `force: true` | 移动 |
| `closet_trash` | 查看回收站批次；`expire: true` 才做过期清理（默认预演） | 只在过期清理时删除 |
| `closet_logs` | 列出某个脚本的执行日志，或读取某份日志的末尾 | 否 |

也可以在 GUI 的 **设置 → 脚本与日志** 面板里点点点。

### 一个典型回合

```
用户：这次排查完了，把临时脚本收拾一下
AI  ：closet_register { path: ".dsh-fix/upgrade-wbc.ps1", purpose: "升级 workbuddy 连接器", status: "done" }
AI  ：closet_scan → 发现 8 个遗留物（3 个 .bak、2 个日志、3 个临时脚本），附判定理由
用户：前 5 个可以清
AI  ：closet_clean { paths: [...] } → 已移入回收站批次 20261018-165530
```

## 支持的语言

按扩展名自动识别，多语言通用：

| 语言 | 扩展名 | 缺省解释器 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PowerShell | `.ps1` `.psm1` `.psd1` | `pwsh`，缺失时退到 `powershell.exe` |
| Node | `.js` `.mjs` `.cjs` `.ts` | `node` |
| Python | `.py` | `python`，缺失时退到 `py -3` |
| 批处理 | `.bat` `.cmd` | `cmd.exe /d /c` |
| Shell | `.sh` `.bash` `.zsh` | `bash` |

解释器路径可在配置里覆盖，见下。

## 配置

写在插件条目的 `config` 下（`cordis.yml`，或安装后由 `cordis.patch.yml` 注入的默认值）：

```yaml
dsh-closet:
  enabled: true
  dataDir: .dsh-fix              # 收纳间目录名，相对工作区
  trashRetentionDays: 30         # 回收站保留天数
  ignore: []                     # 额外忽略的目录名或 glob，如 ['*.bak', 'build']
  maxScanFiles: 5000             # 扫描上限，防止在大仓库里扫穿
  maxScanDepth: 64               # 扫描最大深度
  runTimeoutMs: 120000           # 单次执行超时（毫秒）
  maxLogBytes: 2097152           # 单个日志文件上限（字节）
  maxCleanBatch: 200             # 单次最多清运多少项
  maxCleanBytes: 209715200       # 单次最多清运多少字节（200 MB）
  interpreters: {}               # 覆盖解释器，键为语言名，值为 argv 数组
```

`ignore` 里写错的值会被丢弃而不是「忽略一切」——配置写坏只会让扫描结果变多，不会让它变空。

## 面板

安装后在 **设置 → 脚本与日志** 里：

- 已登记脚本：状态、路径、运行次数；文件已被删掉的会标红提示。
- 扫描遗留物：勾选后点「移进回收站」，一次一批。表头第一个复选框可一键全选（被 git 跟踪的文件不参与），部分勾选时显示半选状态。
- 回收站：按批次列出体积与条目，可一键还原。
- 执行日志：按脚本分组，点开看最近 200 行。

面板接口走 `/dsh-closet/api/*`，只接受同源请求（拒 `cross-site` 与 `origin: null`）。

## 安全设计

- **不会误删**：`closet_clean` 只移动；真正删除只有 `closet_trash { expire: true }` 一条路，默认 `dryRun`。
- **不动版本库里的东西**：扫描会照常列出已被 git 跟踪的文件（标 `tracked` + 「⚠ 已被 git 跟踪」），但判定固定为「待确认」，`closet_clean` 默认整批拒收；确需处理要显式带 `force: true`。工作区不是 git 仓库或本机没装 git 时，保护自动降级并在结果里明说。
- **不会越界**：只能处理**工作区内**的文件；`..` 穿越、大小写变体、软链接/目录联接绕过都被拦截（字面路径与真实路径双重校验）。
- **不会扫穿**：`node_modules`、`.git` 等默认跳过，软链接不跟随，深度与文件数有上限。
- **不会写坏**：`registry.json` 走「写临时文件 → rename」的原子写；文件损坏时先改名留存现场再重建。
- **不会拖死**：脚本执行有超时保护，超时用 `taskkill /T` 连同子进程整棵树杀掉（POSIX 走进程组）。

## 开发

```bash
npm test           # 单测 108 + 端到端冒烟 18 + 文档一致性；零依赖，全用 Node 内置 test runner
npm run test:unit  # 只跑单测
npm run lint:syntax
```

项目结构：

```
lib/
├── store.js    登记册读写（原子写、路径规范化、语言识别）
├── scan.js     遗留物扫描（只读）
├── run.js      多语言执行（spawn + 日志 + 超时 + 进程树强杀）
├── trash.js    回收站（移动/还原/过期清理）
├── config.js   配置归一化 + 原生 Schemastery schema（拿不到内核依赖时用自带的兼容 schema）
├── routes.js   HTTP 面板接口
├── client.js   设置面板（CJS factory 单文件，无需构建）
└── index.js    插件入口，7 个工具的定义与装配

test/
├── *.test.js       单测（store / scan / run / trash / contract）
├── smoke.mjs       端到端冒烟：真 ctx + 真文件系统，工具与路由都跑一遍
├── docs-check.mjs  文档与实现一致性（工具名 / 模块 / 版本号）
└── host-stubs.js   把 @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm 等宿主包替换成桩，让纯 Node 也能 import 入口
```

`store` / `scan` / `run` / `trash` 四层**不依赖 DSH**，可以单独用、单独测、换宿主也能跑。

`lib/client.js` 是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` CJS factory，改完不需要重启，HMR 会自己刷新（React 组件状态会丢）。改 `lib/index.js`、`package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml` 需要重启 DSH。

## 许可

MIT

# DSH Intelligent UI **让 AI 的回答成为你可以操作的界面。** 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中生成计算器、交互图表、地图、原理演示和小型应用。
从一句自然语言开始，完成「生成 → 交互 → 保存重放 → 追问」。 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4D6BFE)](#兼容性) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.19-339933)](#快速开始) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-Host_%2B_Client-3178C6)](docs/architecture.md) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-stdio-6B7280)](#独立-mcp) **中文** · [English](README.en.md) [快速开始](#快速开始) · [演示视频](#demo-explanation) · [使用示例](#在对话中使用) · [工具清单](#工具清单) · [高德地图](#高德地图) · [开发文档](#开发与贡献)
--- ## 为什么使用它 有些问题，需要亲手调节参数、比较选项，或看一遍过程。 DSH Intelligent UI 为这些问题提供交互式呈现。你描述目标，当前 DSH 模型调用工具生成界面，插件负责校验、显示和保存。界面中的按钮还可以携带当前参数，经过你的确认后，将问题送回原会话继续讨论。 | 想做什么 | 可以生成什么 | 试着这样说 | | --- | --- | --- | | 搞懂一个原理 | 带参数、动画与公式的演示 | “用可调摆长的单摆解释周期。” | | 比较几种选择 | 对比卡片、评分或交互计算器 | “做一个三种方案的成本比较器。” | | 展示一组数据 | 表格、柱状图、饼图、折线图 | “把这些数值画成图，注明单位和来源。” | | 介绍地点或路线 | 地图、地点卡片、照片和行程播放 | “在地图上介绍某地的三个景点。” | | 做一个小工具 | 表单控件、计算器、DOM/SVG/Canvas 应用 | “生成一个可以直接操作的单位换算器。” | | 收集选择、展示进度 | 会议时间选择、只读工作流 | “让我从这三个会议时间中选择一个。” | ## 核心能力 - **在聊天里直接操作**：支持 HTML、CSS、JavaScript，以及 DOM、SVG、Canvas。生成过程中先显示静态预览，工具成功后再启用交互。 - **结果持续显示**：使用独立的聊天结果节点，保留工具返回的界面；支持历史重放、重置和单文件 HTML 导出。 - **界面跟随宿主**：适配 DSH 浅色/深色、字号和字体，内容自动测高，并显示可捕获的脚本运行错误。 - **常用组件开箱可用**：六种模板、结构化文本表格、内置 Chart.js 4.5.1 和 Leaflet 1.9.4，无需生成代码加载 CDN。 - **高德地图接入**：支持高德地点搜索与官方静态底图，保留地点标记、选点、缩放、平移和行程播放；Key 只在 Host 侧使用。 - **资源可追溯**：保留原有 OpenFreeMap 与百科/Commons 图片模式，展示地点来源和图片署名；个别地点无法定位时明确提示，其余已确认地点继续显示。 - **交互回到原会话**：追问经用户确认后提交，区分“等待确认”“已入队”和模型的运行、完成、失败或取消状态。 - **也能独立作为 MCP 使用**：复用文档校验、模板和 HTML 装配；适合需要自行接入渲染容器的客户端。 ## 快速开始 ### 兼容性 | 项目 | 当前要求与范围 | | --- | --- | | 插件版本 | `1.2.1` | | DSH 宿主 | **`0.2.1-rc.2`** | | 已验证的客户端路径 | Windows 发行版 CLI 启动的独立 **Web profile** | | Node.js | **22.19+**；当前本地验证使用 Node 24 | | 辅助启动脚本 | PowerShell 7，自动发现 Windows 发行版 CLI | | 模型 | 在 DSH 中配置，需能使用工具 | | DSH 源码 | 普通构建不需要；内部 Conversation 投影测试需要匹配标签源码 | ### 使用预构建包安装 已有 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 和正在使用的 Web profile 时，可以直接安装 Release 中的预构建包，无需克隆源码或本地编译： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui/releases/download/v1.2.1/dsh-intelligent-ui.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 将 `web` 替换为实际 profile 名称。安装后按宿主提示刷新或重启；模型服务使用该 profile 自己的配置。下方是源码开发和独立实例的启动方式。 ### 1. 获取并构建 ```sh git clone https://github.com/NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui.git cd dsh-intelligent-ui npm ci npm run build npm run check ``` 构建使用锁文件中的 rc.2 SDK，不再依赖 alpha.4 源码链接。`lib/`、`dist/` 和预览页面都是生成产物；从 Git 获取源码后需要先构建。 ### 2. 离线预览 ```sh npm run preview ``` 这会生成并打开本地演示页面，无需配置模型。你可以检查控件、计算、重置与追问确认；预览中的追问只记录演示请求，不会发送到 DSH。 在无图形环境中只生成页面并打印位置： ```sh npm run preview -- --no-open ``` ### 3. 在发行版 DSH 中启动 确认已安装 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，在项目目录执行： ```powershell pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 ``` 脚本会构建插件、创建独立 `intelligent-ui` Web profile、通过官方插件管理器安装本地目录，然后启动并打开浏览器。默认端口为 `3098`；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时，配置和会话放在项目的 `artifacts/dsh-home` 下。 在新打开的 DSH 中配置模型服务，再发送下面的测试提示词。独立 profile 不会自动复制你日常客户端的模型配置和凭据。
自定义启动路径、端口与配置检查 ```powershell # 端口已占用时 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -Port 3099 # 只安装并检查合成配置，不启动服务 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -Check # 不自动打开浏览器 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -NoOpen # 自定义发行版官方 CLI 的位置 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -DshCli '~\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' ``` 也可通过 `DSH_CLI` 指定官方启动器，通过 `DSH_HOME` 指定数据目录，通过 `-Profile` 指定 profile 名称。脚本会检查宿主版本，遇到不匹配时停止。 若要装入已有 profile，请使用该客户端的插件管理入口或官方 `dsh plugin --profile add <本地项目目录>`，并确保使用同一个 `DSH_HOME` 和官方 CLI。上面的独立实例启动成功，不代表默认桌面 profile 已安装；桌面壳内的完整交互需另行验收。
## 在对话中使用 描述你需要的界面即可；为了首次确认工具链，建议明确要求调用工具。 ### 第一个交互界面 ```text 我想知道FFT算法的可视化表达是什么样的。 ``` **预期结果：** 在 DSH 对话中生成可交互的 FFT 原理演示。若希望调节采样点数、输入信号或逐步观察计算过程，可以在提示词中补充这些要求；具体交互取决于模型生成的界面。 #### 演示视频：FFT 原理可视化 实际操作录屏，约 49 秒：在聊天中查看 FFT 原理、切换输入信号并观察可视化结果。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b8585aaf-acec-4aef-8c22-271d9712d46f [查看或下载原始 MP4](docs/demos/explanation.mp4) ### 更多可复制的提示词
原理演示：单摆 ```text 生成一个交互式单摆演示，可以调节摆长和重力加速度。 提供开始、暂停和重置，展示周期公式、参数单位与理想模型假设。 ```
数据图表：有单位、有来源 ```text 用柱状图比较 A、B、C 三种方案的耗时：12、18、9 分钟。 数据来源注明“用户提供的演示数据”，保留可读的数据表。 ```
地理介绍：高德地点与行程播放 ```text 使用高德地图介绍上海的豫园、外滩、南京东路、陆家嘴、武康路和新天地，城市指定上海。 按地点名称查询，提供地点卡片、选点和行程播放，并保留来源链接。 ``` 需先按[高德地图](#高德地图)配置 Web服务 Key。高德底图是固定区域快照，放大不会加载新瓦片，站点连线不是道路导航；该模式不自动请求百科照片。原有 OpenFreeMap 模式仍可配合百科/Commons 图片使用。 首次准备地图需要联网。个别地点缺少可验证坐标时，会列入“尚未定位”提示，其余地点继续显示；所有地点均无法定位时才返回定位失败。底图下载、权限或配额错误会报告具体原因。
#### 演示视频：上海六站行程地图 实际操作录屏，约 15 秒：查看高德底图上的六个地点、地点卡片和行程播放。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f0c09349-31e8-40ab-8ec4-137fc49d2de1 [查看或下载原始 MP4](docs/demos/map.mp4)
交互小应用：小游戏 ```text 生成一个复古风格的打砖块小游戏，支持键盘操作。 提供开始、暂停、重新开始、分数和操作说明。 ``` 复杂游戏和科学模拟仍需实际操作确认逻辑正确性。
#### 演示视频：复古打砖块游戏 实际操作录屏，约 19 秒：展示聊天中生成的复古掌机界面与打砖块游戏。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75ea5215-ed3f-4e43-b1ba-41be68d12751 [查看或下载原始 MP4](docs/demos/game.mp4) ### 如何验证主线 1. **模型调用工具**：检查轨迹；默认先选择展示形式，再调用 UI、表格或专项工具。 2. **显示交互界面**：确认出现卡片并能操作，而不只是模型声称“已生成”。 3. **保存与重放**：等待本轮结束，刷新并重新打开同一会话，确认保存的界面仍可渲染。 4. **追问回到会话**：在界面内发起追问，在宿主确认后，检查当前会话收到消息及模型回复。 保存的是界面文档和资源，**不保证保留滑块位置、游戏分数等临时运行状态**。重置或重新挂载会重新运行界面。导出的 HTML 可独立交互，但不能直接向 DSH 发送追问。 ## 工具清单 默认 `routing: model` 时注册 **11 个工具**。关闭展示路由后为 10 个；模型在某一阶段能看到的渲染工具还会随当前展示选择变化。 | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `select_intelligent_ui_presentation` | 为当前用户消息选择 `text`、`table`、`ui` 或 `mixed`；由当前模型决定，无独立分类服务 | | `render_intelligent_ui` | 生成通用交互界面，分别提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript | | `get_intelligent_ui_template` | 获取 `calculator`、`comparison`、`flowchart`、`chart_line`、`chart_bar`、`chart_pie` 模板 | | `render_intelligent_table` | 展示只读文本表格，最多 12 列、200 行 | | `render_intelligent_chart` | 通过结构化参数生成柱状图或饼图，附单位、来源与数据表 | | `render_intelligent_map` | 按配置使用高德底图快照或原有 OpenFreeMap 模式，展示地点、卡片和行程播放 | | `lookup_intelligent_ui_places` | 高德模式按名称与城市查询 POI，返回 GCJ-02 坐标；原有模式查询百科坐标，均保留来源 | | `search_intelligent_ui_images` | 搜索 Commons 图片文件名与署名，最多返回 4 项 | | `plan_intelligent_ui` | 展示可视化方案、技术选择和关键元素 | | `render_intelligent_workflow` | 展示只读任务状态快照，不执行或推进任务 | | `choose_intelligent_meeting_time` | 通过 DSH 人工问答选择会议时间，不创建预约 | 展示路由是同一个会话模型的一次工具选择。需要 UI 时，先完成选择，再在后续模型步骤调用渲染工具；不需要可视化的问题可以直接用文字回答。 注册实现：[Host 入口](src/index.ts) · [专项工具](src/host/features.ts) · [展示路由](src/host/routing.ts)。 ## 工作原理 ```mermaid flowchart LR A[用户描述需求] --> B[当前 DSH 模型] B --> C[选择展示形式并调用工具] C --> D[Host 校验并保存文档及资源] D --> E[持久聊天节点] E --> F[隔离 iframe 中显示和交互] D --> G[历史重放 / HTML 导出] F --> H[宿主确认追问] H --> B ``` Host 管理工具、资源获取和文档校验；Client 管理聊天节点、iframe、主题和消息桥接；DSH 继续管理模型、会话、队列与人工问答。界面资源保存在工具结果 metadata 中，重放时无需重新让模型生成整份界面。 生成代码在独立来源、`sandbox="allow-scripts"` 的 iframe 内运行。流式阶段不执行生成脚本；成功后启用脚本。追问和外链经受限桥接交给宿主确认。 工具失败时，卡片会显示可用的具体错误文本，历史重放也保留该错误；失败或中断的预览不会启用脚本。 ### 界面与会话桥接 ```javascript try { const receipt = await window.dshUI.sendPrompt('请解释当前参数对应的结果'); // 这里只代表确认/入队结果，不代表模型已经回复。 } catch (error) { // 处理用户取消或提交失败。 } const unsubscribe = window.dshUI.onRunStatus(event => { // 按 requestId 关联；completed 表示对应模型轮次完成。 console.log(event.requestId, event.status); }); ``` 还提供主题订阅、外链确认与错误报告。完整字段、版本和边界见 [运行契约](docs/runtime.md)。 ## 配置 ### 高德地图 高德模式使用 **Web服务 Key**：Host 调用地点搜索、坐标转换和官方静态地图接口，Leaflet 负责聊天卡片中的显示和交互。不需要申请 Web端（JS API）Key；当前实现也不是高德 JS 动态瓦片地图。 1. 在高德控制台为应用申请 **Web服务** Key。 2. 在插件根目录创建 `.env`，写入 `DSH_AMAP_KEY=你的高德Web服务Key`。默认自动读取该文件，与 DSH 的启动目录无关；修改后重启 DSH。也可用 `amapEnvFile` 指定其他 `.env` 路径。 3. 复制 [amap.example.yml](preview/amap.example.yml) 为 `preview/amap.local.yml`，填入真实文件路径： ```yaml - id: intelligent-ui config: mapProvider: amap # amapEnvFile: 'D:/keys/.env' # Optional; defaults to the plugin root .env amapTimeoutMs: 15000 ``` 4. 用覆盖层启动独立 Web profile： ```powershell pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run-dsh.ps1 -I
