复跑：`node tools/contrast.mjs`（硬性项不达标会以非零码退出）。

## 实现方式（可维护性）

DSH 的 `ctx.theme` 提供两种扩展点。设置里的「外观」行只有 `light / dark / system` 三个硬编码方块，第三方 `register()` 的 theme id 既不进 UI 也不进设置 schema（不持久化），所以本插件走官方认可的第二种：

- `ctx.theme.overrideTokens(source, { token: { light, dark } })` 叠加一层别名令牌；
- 自建一行 `settings.general.item` 做切换；
- 只在**解析后的外观是深色**时叠加图层，浅色时撤掉——因此浅色外观与原生逐像素一致；
- 图层值由 `ui-layout` presenter 写成 body 内联 CSS 变量，切换/卸载时自动回退。

### 目录结构

```
dsh-theme-one-dark-pro/
├── PLAN.md                     # 设计/实施计划
├── README.md                   # 本文件
├── package.json                # bundle + client manifest
├── cordis.patch.yml            # 插入本插件的 loader row
├── index.js                    # Host 半边（空 apply，只为让客户端 bundle 被发现）
├── client.js                   # 构建产物：ModuleLoader bundle
├── src/client.template.js      # 可编辑的运行时源码（含 __TOKENS__ 占位）
├── themes/one-dark-pro.json    # 令牌映射真源（暗色值 + 出处注释）
├── locale/{en,zh}.json         # 插件页展示文案
├── icon.svg                    # 原创图标
├── tools/
│   ├── build.mjs               # 生成 client.js（含覆盖率校验）
│   ├── contrast.mjs            # 对比度审计
│   ├── test-runtime.mjs        # 运行时行为测试（无浏览器）
│   ├── reference/
│   │   ├── dsh-defaults.json   # DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 默认令牌双面值快照
│   │   └── onedark-palette.json# One Dark Pro 色值参考（含语法作用域）
│   └── reference/render-palette.py  # 生成 docs/onedark-palette.png
└── docs/onedark-palette.png    # 色板图
```

### 重建

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
node tools/build.mjs        # 改 themes/*.json 或 src/client.template.js 后必须重建
node tools/contrast.mjs     # 对比度审计
node tools/test-runtime.mjs # 运行时行为测试
```

DSH 大版本升级后，如果官方浅色调色板有变，重跑一次默认值提取并更新 `tools/reference/dsh-defaults.json` 再构建即可。

## 已知边界

- **只做深色**：浅色外观完全沿用 DSH 默认（图层在浅色下会被撤掉）。
- **静态色阶只覆盖被组件直接引用的 16 个**：`--dsw-static-neutral-850/800/700` 等被 DSH 组件直接当卡片/悬停底色用，必须一起映射，否则和别的主题插件（如护眼配色）叠加时会被染成土黄/橄榄色。其余未被引用的静态步进与 `--dsw-shadow-*`、字号/字体/圆角令牌不动。
- **8 个组件专用令牌**：`bg-l1`、`bg-layer-4`、`fill-l1/l2/tertiary`、`fill-tsp-secondary`、`label-quaternary`、`separator-primary` 被 DSH 组件引用但当前 ui-theme 样式表未定义；本插件按 One Dark Pro 语义补了值（否则这些位置无主题色）。
- `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` 是滤镜不是颜色，保持 DSH 默认。
- 第三方插件里**写死**的颜色无法覆盖（DSH 自带组件没有此问题）。
- 与本 profile 里已安装的 `@xiaotuchu/dsh-theme-eye-care` 同时启用时，两层会按“后叠加逐令牌获胜”混合。建议在其「背景色」行选「原生」或禁用，避免两套配色混搭。
- 本插件不是 VS Code 官方或 One Dark Pro 作者发布的项目，名称仅用于说明配色来源。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-theme-one-dark-pro
```

卸载或选「原生」后界面立即恢复 DSH 默认，插件不改动 DSH 自身文件。

## 许可

插件代码 MIT。One Dark Pro 配色来自 MIT 许可的 VS Code 扩展（© Zhuang TongFa / Binaryify 等），本仓库仅使用颜色数据。

plugins.description: Time & Timer for DeepSeek Harness: synced clock, lunar date, China holidays, and a 15-minute timer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-time&timer > Visual clock and timer plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI.

在 Harness 的对话界面里内置一个与系统时间同步的可视化时钟：首页显示大号数字时钟（含农历、中国法定节假日与调休），对话进行时在标题栏显示紧凑时间条；两种形态都带一个最多 15 分钟的计时器入口。 ## 功能 ### 两种时钟形态 | 模式 | 出现时机 | 位置与尺寸 | |---|---|---| | **StartMode** | 首页 / 空白会话（Hero 页） | 对话区域左上角，`256 × 64 px` 横向数字时钟卡片 | | **DefaultMode** | 任意对话进行时 | 标题栏左侧工具区（标题旁的 actions 组）最右端，JetBrains Mono 14px | - 时间统一为 24 小时制 `HH:MM:SS`，每秒刷新。 - StartMode 顶部：公历年 `YY/MM/DD`（如 `26/10/18`）+ 节假日 / 休息日徽标（`国庆节·休`、`春节·班`）。 - StartMode 中部：`HH:MM:SS` 作为视觉焦点（HH:MM 30px + 秒 18px），居中偏左。 - StartMode 底部：农历日期，格式 `丙午年.九月初九`（含生肖年干支），默认关闭、可在插件设置中开启。 - DefaultMode：时间条带一层加深底色块（含 1px 内描边），时间与蓝色计时按钮整体成为标题栏里的聚焦区域。 - 两种模式的计时器入口采用同一套蓝色强调： - StartMode：`64 × 24` 矩形按钮； - DefaultMode：`24 × 24` 正方形按钮； - 顶部边缘线均有 1px 白色高光（`inset 0 1px 0 #fff`，高光仅出现在边缘线上），图标颜色 `#27F5F5`。 ### 双时间来源 - 默认采信**系统时间**（浏览器 `Date`）。 - 在插件设置中开启**第三方时间服务器**后，Host 半通过 UDP 向 `ntp.aliyun.com` 查询，Client 按偏移量校正显示；每 5 分钟重新同步一次，失败自动回退系统时间并在设置页显示错误。 - 浏览器无法直接发送 NTP（UDP/123），因此 Host 半注册了 `GET /api/time-n-timer/ntp` 路由；该路由只查询固定的 `ntp.aliyun.com`，不是通用 NTP 代理。 ### 计时器（Timer） - 上限 15 分钟；倒计时档位：`15s / 30s / 1min / 3min / 5min / 10min / 15min`；另有正向计时模式（最多 15:00）。 - 点击任意模式的计时按钮打开对话框，进行模式与时长选择；支持开始 / 暂停 / 继续 / 重置。 - 到点自动打开对话框提示「时间到」，并播放三声提示音。 - 计时进行中按钮带状态点（运行 / 暂停 / 结束）；StartMode 顶部徽标在计时中改为显示剩余时间。 - 计时器状态保存在当前页面内存，刷新页面后重置。 ### 插件设置 `设置 → 通用` 中新增「时间与计时器」两行： 1. **显示农历日期**（默认关闭） 2. **第三方时间服务器**（默认关闭；开启后显示同步状态、偏移量与错误） 设置持久化在浏览器 `localStorage` 的 `dsh.time-n-timer.settings.v1`。 ## 安装 ### 方式一：从 GitHub 克隆后本地安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Depar7ure/dsh-time-timer.git ``` 在 Harness 的 **Plugin Manager → 安装本地插件（Install bundle）** 中选择克隆下来的目录，安装后刷新页面即可。 ### 方式二：交给 Harness Agent 安装 把该目录的绝对路径交给 Agent，并说明「安装这个 bundle」；Harness 会通过 `install_bundle` 完成安装（安装后刷新页面）。 > 插件显示名：**Time & Timer / 时间与计时器**。 ## 项目结构 ``` dsh-time-timer/ ├── index.js # Host 半：NTP 查询路由（node:dgram） ├── client.js # Client 半：时钟 / 农历 / 节假日 / 计时器 / 弹窗 / 设置行 ├── cordis.patch.yml # Bundle patch（插入一行 dsh-time-timer） ├── package.json # 包清单（dsh.bundle + dsh.client） ├── locale/ │ ├── en.json # 插件显示名与描述（English） │ └── zh.json # 插件显示名与描述（中文） ├── icon.svg # 插件图标 ├── scripts/check.mjs # 本地清单与语法自检 ├── CHANGELOG.md ├── LICENSE # MIT └── README.md ``` ## 数据说明 - **农历**：内置 1900–2100 标准农历表（支持闰月）。已验证 2026-02-17 = 正月初一、2026-09-25 = 八月十五、2026-10-18 = 九月初九。 - **节假日**：内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅放假安排（含调休上班日）；无数据的年份按周末规则回退。普通周六 / 周日显示「周末·休」，调休上班日显示「班」。 - 节假日数据来源：国务院办公厅《关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2025〕7 号）。 ## 开发 ```bash node scripts/check.mjs # 清单、图标、Client 半语法检查 node --check index.js # Host 半语法检查（ESM） ``` 要求：Harness 的 Web 客户端（`dsh.client.platform: web`）；Node.js ≥ 18（Host 半使用 `node:dgram`）。 ## 兼容性与已知限制 - 节假日数据目前覆盖 2025–2026，其他年份仅按周末判定。 - 样式使用 Harness 的主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），浅色 / 深色主题均可用；字号与尺寸依赖宿主布局，宿主大版本升级后可能需要重新核对槽位。 - StartMode 通过 `conversation.header.leading` 渲染；DefaultMode 通过 `conversation.session.header.actions` 渲染，空白会话时该槽位不会显示。 - NTP 同步依赖 Host 半与网络可达；离线环境自动回退系统时间。 ## English **dsh-time-timer** is a visual clock and timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. It shows a 256×64 digital clock on the home (blank) session with an optional Chinese lunar date and China holiday badge, and a compact JetBrains Mono clock strip in the header while a conversation is active. Both modes expose a timer launcher (countdown presets from 15 seconds to 15 minutes, plus a stopwatch capped at 15:00). Time is taken from the system clock by default and can optionally be corrected from `ntp.aliyun.com` through a Host-side NTP endpoint. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 Depar7ure

plugins.description: MCP bridge for DSH: Codex dispatches coding tasks to a DSH headless agent over a loopback Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-mcp

A **DSH host plugin** that runs a loopback-only **Streamable HTTP MCP server** inside the DeepSeek Harness process, so **Codex can dispatch coding work to DSH** over MCP — no shell wrapper, no per-call script.

[中文说明](#中文说明) · MIT · zero runtime dependencies

```
Codex CLI
  └─ MCP (Streamable HTTP + Bearer token)      http://127.0.0.1:39391/mcp
       └─ DSH host plugin dsh-codex-mcp        (lives inside the DSH process)
            └─ node <dsh install>/lib/bin.js --profile headless --json
                 └─ DSH reads/writes code, runs commands, streams NDJSON events
```

DSH is still the agent that writes the code. Codex only dispatches the task, reads back a structured result, and re-runs the acceptance command itself.

![dsh-codex-mcp: Codex dispatches to a DSH headless agent over a loopback MCP endpoint](assets/screenshot-1.png)

![Install, check and dispatch from the terminal](assets/screenshot-2.png)

---

## Why a plugin and not a DSH tool

A regular DSH agent tool (`ctx.tools`) is visible only to DSH's own model — Codex cannot see it. To be callable from another agent, the capability has to leave the process. This plugin therefore:

- starts an HTTP MCP endpoint on `127.0.0.1` when the DSH host loads it, and closes it when the plugin unloads (`ctx.effect` returns a disposer);
- speaks the MCP Streamable HTTP transport and legacy JSON-RPC directly — the package deliberately has **no dependencies**, so there is no MCP SDK or `@deepseek-ai/*` package to resolve inside a profile;
- reuses the DSH install that hosts it: it finds `@deepseek-ai/dsh`'s `lib/bin.js` next to `resources/app`, or wherever `DSH_APP_ROOT` / `dshCli` points.

## Features

- **Three MCP tools** — `dsh_env`, `dsh_run`, `dsh_resume`. New sessions and follow-ups both carry the session id back to the caller.
- **Structured results** — final answer, `session`, `cwd`, `exit`, `turn_end`, per-turn token usage, step count, duration; failures also return the stderr tail and a classified reason.
- **Honest failure** — a call is an MCP error when: it timed out, the child exited non-zero, `turn_end` was not `completed`, no `final` event arrived, or the final answer is empty. DSH's own "I'm done" is never taken at face value by the plugin.
- **Process-tree kill** on timeout (`taskkill /T /F` on Windows, process group elsewhere), so no orphaned agents.
- **Concurrency cap** (`maxConcurrentRuns`, default 4) — extra calls fail fast instead of queueing silently.
- **Loopback-only + Bearer token** — token generated on first start (`32` random bytes, `0600`), compared with sha256 + `timingSafeEqual`, path `$DSH_HOME/codex-mcp.token` by default.
- **Bounded NDJSON parsing** — malformed lines are counted, not fatal; event count, line size and stderr tail are all capped.
- **Bilingual tool descriptions** (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`) so the calling model reads instructions in its own language.

## Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | Desktop or CLI install whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh` supports `--profile headless --json` |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the host's own Node is used) |
| DSH credentials | a model API key already stored in your `~/.dsh` profile (the GUI Models page or the credentials service) |
| DSH profile | a `headless` profile; the desktop profile rejects `--json` and is managed by the desktop app |

## Install

```sh
# from GitHub (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:GEB-lab/dsh-codex-mcp

# from a release tarball
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/GEB-lab/dsh-codex-mcp/releases/latest/download/dsh-codex-mcp.tgz

# local checkout, for development (changes apply after a host restart)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-codex-mcp
```

`dsh plugin` is the DSH plugin command: it forwards to the profile's package manager, then selects the new bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles`. If HMR is on, the plugin loads immediately; otherwise restart DSH.

Check that it came up:

```sh
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:39391/mcp -X POST \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.dsh/codex-mcp.token)" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{}}}'
```

or, without curl:

```sh
node scripts/smoke.mjs                        # protocol + dsh_env only, spends no tokens
node scripts/smoke.mjs --task "reply SMOKE_OK" --cwd /path/to/project
```

The smoke script prints the exact `config.toml` block for your machine.

## Codex configuration

`~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.dsh_codex]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39391/mcp"
http_headers = { Authorization = "Bearer <contents of $DSH_HOME/codex-mcp.token>" }
startup_timeout_sec = 30
tool_timeout_sec = 3600
enabled = true
```

`codex mcp list` should then show `dsh_codex … enabled  Bearer token`.

Then, from Codex:

> Use `dsh_run` to have DSH, in `C:\work\proj`, add typed input support to `src/sum.mjs` plus three `node:test` cases; only touch `src/` and `test/`. After it returns, run `node --test test\*.test.mjs` yourself and report the result.

## Tool reference

### `dsh_env()`
No side effects, no tokens spent. Returns JSON: `plugin{name,version,pid,startedAt}`, `mcp{url,token,tokenFile}`, `dsh{cli,version,profile,dshHome,permissionMode,node,nodeVersion}`, `defaults{cwd,timeoutSec}`, `runtime{activeRuns,maxConcurrentRuns}`, and a ready-to-paste `codexConfig` snippet.

### `dsh_run(task, cwd?, timeout_sec?, include_events?)`
Starts a **new** headless session. `task` is sent on stdin (no quoting problems, no argv length limit). On success the text result looks like:

```
[DSH done] turn 1 · steps 1 · 2.9s
session: session-1a2b3c4d-...
cwd: /work/proj
exit: 0 · turn_end: completed
usage: in 469 / out 8 / cacheRead 5760 / total 6237

--- final answer ---
DSH_PLUGIN_OK

--- continue this session ---
dsh_resume({ "session_id": "session-1a2b3c4d-...", "task": "<next task>" })
```

### `dsh_resume(session_id, task, cwd?, timeout_sec?)`
Continues an existing session. It must run in the **same `cwd`** as the original, otherwise DSH refuses before starting (and the plugin says so).

Failure payloads carry the classification (`timed out`, `exit code N`, `turn_end was X`, `no final answer`, `empty final answer`), the stderr tail, event counts, and a next-step hint for the usual causes (missing credentials, wrong profile, unknown session, cwd mismatch, unauthorized).

## Configuration

All keys live under this entry's `config` in `cordis.patch.yml` (bundle default) or in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (your override):

```yaml
- id: dsh-codex-mcp
  name: dsh-codex-mcp
  config:
    port: 39400
    defaultCwd: 'D:\code'
```

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | bind address; non-loopback is refused unless `allowNonLoopback: true` |
| `port` | `39391` | `0` picks a free port (`dsh_env` reports the real one) |
| `path` | `/mcp` | endpoint path |
| `tokenFile` | `$DSH_HOME/codex-mcp.token` | Bearer token; created when missing |
| `regenerateToken` | `false` | rotate the token on next start |
| `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh` | child `DSH_HOME` |
| `profile` | `headless` | child DSH profile |
| `permissionMode` | `danger-full-access` | child `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE` |
| `defaultCwd` | host cwd | used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `defaultTimeoutSec` | `3600` | per-call timeout |
| `maxConcurrentRuns` | `4` | parallel headless tasks |
| `dshCli` | auto-detected | explicit path to `…/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js` |
| `nodePath` | auto-detected | explicit Node executable |
| `locale` | `zh` | `en` or `zh` for MCP tool text |
| `includeEvents` | `false` | append the raw NDJSON event tail to results |

`~/`, relative paths and `$DSH_HOME` are expanded; unknown keys are ignored.

## Security model

- Binds `127.0.0.1` by default. Requests whose peer is not loopback are rejected even if you widen the bind, unless you opt in with `allowNonLoopback: true`.
- Every request needs the Bearer token; the endpoint returns `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="dsh-codex-mcp"` otherwise. Token comparison is constant-time over SHA-256 di

plugins.description: DSH plugin: lists the files a conversation turn produced or changed as plain text, and reveals a file in the OS file manager on double-click.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-GotoFile > 对话结尾列出本轮**产出 / 修改**的文件，**双击路径**直接在资源管理器里定位。 > A DSH plugin that prints the files a turn produced or changed — **double-click a path to reveal it in your OS file manager.** DSH 的官方「改动文件」卡片只活在浏览器里：要离开 GUI 读一份清单、要整段复制路径、要在资源管理器里打开文件，都得再手动翻一遍。这个插件把同一份「本轮改动」数据渲染成**纯文本行**放进对话结尾，并让每一行路径都能双击落到系统文件管理器。 ``` 本轮产出 / 修改 3 个文件（双击路径在文件管理器中定位） [复制全部] ● 新 report.md — E:\workspace\project\docs\report.md 📂 ● 改 index.js — E:\workspace\project\src\index.js 📂 ● 改 old-config.yml — E:\workspace\project\old-config.yml （已不存在） ``` 真实运行效果（结尾的文本块：「已编辑 3 个文件」卡片是 DSH 自带的，下面一行才是本插件）： ![turn-tail 文本报告](assets/screenshot-turn-tail.png) ## 特性 - **文本，不是卡片**：整段可选中、可复制（右上角「复制全部」一键拷走全部绝对路径），粘贴到哪里都好用。 - **双击即定位**：双击路径文本 → Windows 资源管理器（`explorer /select,`）与 macOS Finder（`open -R`）会打开并**选中**该文件；Linux 没有统一的「在文件管理器中选中」接口，`xdg-open` 只能**打开文件本身**（目录则打开该目录）。 - **正文里的路径也能双击**：`` `src/index.js` `` 这种裸路径、或手动选中的一段路径，双击同样生效——不用回到报告里找。 - **只记真的写成功的**：登记 `write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor` / `ops_replace` 的**成功**调用，失败的、只读的调用一律不出现。 - **新 / 改 有区分**：本轮首次写入该路径 = **新**；改动一个已存在的文件 = **改**。 - **失效文件自动置灰**：文件被外部删掉的行显示「（已不存在）」并禁用双击。 - **零依赖、无构建**：两个源文件（宿主半 + 浏览器半），`node --test` 直接跑单测。 - **默认就安全**：所有路由先过本机同源校验（Origin 的端口必须与请求 Host 的端口一致，本地别的开发端口一律拒绝），请求体只收 `application/json`；只有会话工作目录 / 家目录（凭据类目录除外）/ 用户显式声明的白名单根里的路径才能被系统打开。 ## 安装 已发布到 npm：****（包名只能小写，仓库与插件显示名仍写作 *dsh-GotoFile*）。 **方式一：官方 CLI（推荐）** ```bash # 先退出桌面端客户端：desktop profile 在桌面端运行时被独占，plugin 命令会被拒绝 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-gotofile ``` **方式二：手动装进 profile** ```bash cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop" # Windows 下类似 E:\...\2-DSH运行数据\profiles\desktop pnpm add dsh-gotofile # 或 npm i dsh-gotofile ``` 装完 `package.json` 里应该有 `"dsh-gotofile": "^1.0.4"`（`dependencies`）与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的一项 —— 后者是它出现在**插件管理**列表里的前提（只把目录塞进 `node_modules` 而不写依赖，宿主侧能挂载，但插件管理里看不到它）。 然后在同一个 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾登记（DSH 的插件市场/插件管理安装时也会自动写入这一行）： ```yaml - insert: - id: goto-file name: dsh-gotofile ``` 手动安装也行——把整包放进 profile 的 `node_modules`： ``` /node_modules/dsh-gotofile/ /cordis.patch.yml ``` 改完 `cordis.patch.yml` 需要**重启桌面端**（或重新加载 profile）才会挂载。挂载成功可以在插件管理里看到 `goto-file` / `dsh-gotofile` / 状态 `active`。 ## 配置：外置盘 / 网络盘白名单 `设置 → GotoFile`，每行一个根目录（支持 `~/` 与 `~\`），**保存立即生效**，不用重启、不用改 YAML。 - 默认留空 = 只放行**会话工作目录**与**家目录**内的路径；其他位置的路径双击会被拒绝，报告里仍会列出但打开请求返回 404。 - 盘根可以直接填：`D:\`、`F:\` 都行（也接受只写 `D:`，会补成盘根；带不带尾斜杠、盘符大小写都不影响）。 - 家目录里有一批**凭据类目录默认不放行**（`AppData`、`Library`、`.ssh`、`.aws`、`.gnupg`、`.kube`、`.docker`、`.npmrc`、`.netrc`、`.git-credentials`）——这些位置的文件一旦被系统默认程序打开，等于把本机账号交出去。确实需要时把它们写进白名单即可（写进去 = 显式授权）。 - 系统盘特征目录（`C:\` 之类，即根下存在 `Windows` / `System` / `etc`）会被自动拒绝，避免一条白名单把整台机器敞开口。 - 白名单根还会做 `realpath` 逃逸检查（symlink 不能溜出根）。 ## 权限：它会碰什么 - **会话**：只监听 `session/event` 里的 `tool/call` 与 `tool/result`，读取工具名和路径参数并配对；不读对话正文，不改会话数据，不落盘。 - **文件**：只对报告里的路径做存在性检查（`existsSync` / `statSync`）；「打开」交给系统文件管理器（Windows `explorer`、macOS `open -R`、Linux `xdg-open`），经 `execFile` 直传参数、不经 shell，不会执行文件内容。 - **路径范围**：会话工作目录、家目录（`AppData` / `.ssh` / `.npmrc` 等凭据类目录默认拒绝）、你显式声明的白名单根。 - **网络**：**不联网**。没有遥测、没有外部请求；三条路由只服务本机，且校验同源与端口。 *What it touches: session tool events (names + path arguments only, message text is not read), file existence checks, the OS file manager for reveal/open, and no network at all.* ## 工作原理（一图） ``` 一轮对话 │ 工具调用 write / edit / str_replace_editor / ops_replace ▼ 宿主半 lib/index.js ctx.on('session/event') tool/call ──► pending.set(callId, {turn, 路径, 是否新建}) tool/result ──► 只有成功（isError !== true）才计入登记簿 ├ op = 新建且首次收录 ? 'new' : 'edit' └ 子代理会话（origin==='subagent'）不参与 (可选补漏) ctx.get('workspaceChanges').summary(...) → 官方含 git 快照的权威清单 POST /api/goto-file/check → 本轮文件清单 POST /api/goto-file/open → 系统打开 / 定位（同源校验 + 路径安全口径） ▼ 浏览器半 lib/client.js turnTail 槽：渲染纯文本行，双击判 event.detail === 2 → /open reveal 正文双击委托：document dblclick 抓裸 / 选中文本 → /open reveal ``` 源码级查证过的坑（八条，含 `explorer.exe` 把 `/` 当开关、turnTail 槽在 0.1.7 前后的双模签名、`webServer` 必须动态注入等）都记在 [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。 ## 源码结构 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主半：本轮改动登记簿 + 三条 API 路由 + 路径安全判定 + 系统打开 | | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：turn-tail 文本报告、双击委托、设置卡片 | | `test/` | 单测：`host.test.js`（宿主半纯逻辑）+ `manifest.test.js`（包清单一致性），共 30 例，`node --test` | | `docs/architecture.md` | 架构、数据流与关键决策 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 供参考的挂载补丁片段 | ## 开发 ```bash node --test # 30 个单测，零依赖、无需 npm install ``` 宿主半对 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 的依赖是**懒加载**的（挂载时才解析真包，解析不到就退回恒等形态）， 所以这个仓库可以被单独克隆出来直接跑测试，不必放在 DSH profile 里。 ## 已知边界 - **PTC / 单一 `run_code` 模式**：工具面被收拢成一个 `run_code` 之后，写文件不再是独立的 `write` / `edit` 调用， 而是脚本里的 `tools.write({ file_path: "..." })` / `tools.edit({ file_path: "..." })`。本插件会解析脚本提取这些字面量路径 （变量路径、含 `${...}` 的模板串跳过——宁可漏报也不猜）。脚本里用 `pwsh` 重定向写出的文件仍然只能靠官方快照补漏。 - 外部命令产生的文件（`> out.txt`、`git checkout` 等）不在登记簿里，只能靠官方 `workspaceChanges` 的 git 快照补漏；**非 git 目录下这类改动不会出现**。 - `ops_replace` 的 `glob` 参数是**模式**不是路径（`src/*.ts`、`**/*.js`），不会被展开成具体文件；那一轮登记的是它的 `path` 参数，glob 命中的文件靠官方快照补漏。 - 单轮文件数上限 `maxFilesPerTurn`（默认 200），防止病态轮次撑爆登记簿。 - **Linux 上双击是「打开」不是「定位选中」**：`xdg-open` 没有选中参数，双击会用默认程序打开该文件（目录则打开目录）。Windows / macOS 才是资源管理器 / Finder 里定位选中。 - 双击是浏览器手势，纯键盘用户可按 Enter（行有 `tabIndex`）触发定位。 ## License MIT --- ## 打赏 本项目为个人爱好驱动的开源插件，如果帮助到了您，欢迎各位大老板顺手请我喝杯咖啡，非常感谢打赏！
微信
 支付宝

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: multiple working directories per workspace, like Claude's additional directories / /add-dir
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-folders > A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that gives a workspace **multiple working directories**, like Claude's additional directories: add other folders to a workspace from a composer button or `/add-dir`, and the model can read them and (for read-write folders) edit them with pre-approved sandbox escalation. Works with DSH NEXT, DSH Desktop and `dsh web` on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5`. 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）工作区添加**多个工作目录**的插件，效果类似 Claude 的 additional directories / `/add-dir`：除了工作区本身的目录，还可以把其他目录（例如共享库、文档仓库、另一个前端项目）加入同一个工作区，让模型一起读写。 适配 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5`（DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next、DSH Desktop Beta）。不修改上游代码，只通过官方扩展点组合：`systemPrompt.context`、`tools/execute`、`approval/request`、`commands`、`connection.fetch`，以及 Web 客户端的 `conversation.input.left` 槽位。 ## 截图 输入框旁的「工作目录」按钮显示额外目录数量： ![输入框旁的工作目录按钮](docs/screenshots/overview.png)

管理额外目录，切换读写 / 只读
直接输入路径，或「选择文件夹…」（桌面端为系统对话框，浏览器中为应用内浏览器）
斜杠命令 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs`： ![斜杠命令](docs/screenshots/commands.png) ## 功能 - **输入框旁的「工作目录」按钮**（📁 +N）：点开后可添加、移除目录，切换「读写 / 只读」。保存后从下一轮对话起生效，本工作区的所有会话共享。 - 添加目录有两种方式：在输入框里**直接输入**路径（绝对路径或 `~/路径`，回车或点「添加」），或点「**选择文件夹…**」用选择框挑选。 - 同一个目录不能重复添加：添加时立即检查，写法不同但指向同一目录（末尾斜杠、`/tmp` 与 `/private/tmp`、符号链接、`~/…`）也算重复，会提示「已在列表中」并高亮已有的那一行；已在工作区内、或已是全局目录的路径同样会被拒绝。 - 「选择文件夹…」按环境自动选择：在 DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 窗口里打开系统文件夹对话框（Finder，与添加工作区相同）；在本机 `dsh web` 中由 Host 打开系统对话框；在局域网或远程浏览器中显示应用内文件夹浏览器（从工作区所在目录开始，可点路径跳转、显示隐藏文件夹）。 - **斜杠命令**（任何有命令入口的界面都可用）： - `/add-dir <路径> [--read-only]` — 添加目录，支持绝对路径、`~/路径`、相对当前工作目录的路径；目录已在列表中时报错（要改读写权限请先 `/remove-dir`） - `/remove-dir <路径>` — 移除目录 - `/dirs` — 列出当前工作区的全部目录 - **模型可见**：每次请求的运行时上下文（紧跟沙箱策略之后）会列出额外目录及其读写权限；该上下文会写入会话日志，回放时可还原。 - **写入权限**：在默认的 `workspace-write` 沙箱模式下，DSH 只允许修改工作区目录本身。对于标记为「读写」的额外目录，模型使用 `write` / `edit` 工具写入时，插件会自动批准这次沙箱提权（审批记录照常写入会话日志 `approval/asked` / `approval/decided`）。 - 「只读」目录不会自动批准，写入仍会询问你。 - 终端命令（bash）写入额外目录仍走正常的提权确认，因为插件无法可靠判断命令会写哪里。 - 会话处于「只读」模式时不会自动批准任何写入；处于「完全访问」模式时本来就不受限制。 - **全局目录**：可在配置里指定对所有工作区生效的目录。 - **读取额外目录的指令文件**（可选，默认关闭）：开启 `loadInstructions` 后，每个额外目录根部的 `AGENTS.md`（没有时用 `CLAUDE.md`）会作为第二段运行时上下文（紧跟目录列表之后）发给模型，类似 Claude Code 的 `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD`。 ## 安装 ### DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 在应用中打开 **DSH 终端**（托盘菜单或设置顶部的终端入口），执行： ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders ``` 然后完全重启应用（托盘 → **退出并重启**，或设置顶部菜单 → **重启应用**）。输入框工具栏会出现文件夹按钮。 建议固定到某个 commit，避免之后的推送悄悄改变运行的代码：`github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders#`。 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-folders`，然后重启。 ### 普通 `dsh web` ```bash dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders ``` ### 从本地源码安装（开发用） ```bash git clone https://github.com/Fleey/dsh-workspace-folders.git cd dsh-workspace-folders && npm install && npm run build dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:"$PWD" ``` 仓库中已包含构建好的 `lib/`，因此从 GitHub 安装不需要运行构建脚本，也不需要在 profile 中授权 `allowBuilds`。 ## 配置 默认配置见 [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)。要修改，在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`（例如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖这一行，注意要写全保留的键： ```yaml - id: workspace-folders config: autoApproveWrites: true # 设为 false 则读写目录的每次写入都需要确认 globalDirectories: # 对所有工作区生效，~ 会展开为主目录 - { path: ~/notes, access: read-only } # storeFile: /absolute/path.json # 默认 $DSH_HOME/workspace-folders.json loadInstructions: false # 设为 true 则把各额外目录根部的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 发给模型 maxInstructionBytes: 32768 # 指令上下文整体（含说明与标题）的 UTF-8 字节上限 ``` 配置写错（未知键、非绝对路径、非法 access、`maxInstructionBytes` 不是整数或小于截断标记的长度）会在加载时直接报错，而不是被静默忽略。 ### 额外目录的指令文件（`loadInstructions`） - 只看每个额外目录**根部**：优先 `AGENTS.md`；没有可用的 `AGENTS.md` 时才读 `CLAUDE.md`，两者不会同时读取。空白的 `AGENTS.md` 也算「有」，此时不再读 `CLAUDE.md`。 - 读写目录和只读目录都会读取；目录当前不存在、或没有指令文件时直接跳过，不报错。 - 指向目录外部的符号链接（文件本身或其所在路径）一律视为不存在，不会读取；指向目录内部的链接正常读取。非普通文件（目录、FIFO 等）也会跳过。 - 每次组装请求时同步重新读取，所以修改指令文件后从下一次请求起生效；内容变化时会生成新的运行时上下文快照，并像目录列表一样写入会话日志。 - 整段上下文（开头说明、每个目录的标题、正文）合计不超过 `maxInstructionBytes` 字节；超出时在 UTF-8 字符边界处截断，并以 `[Additional-directory instructions truncated here to fit the configured size limit.]` 结尾，后面的目录不再出现。 - 该上下文和目录列表一样是必需上下文（`required`），即使 profile 关闭了可选运行时上下文（`systemPrompt` 的 `includeRuntimeContext: false`）也会保留。 ## 数据存储 目录列表按工作区路径保存在 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-folders.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/workspace-folders.json`）： ```json { "version": 1, "workspaces": { "/path/to/project": { "directories": [ { "path": "/path/to/shared-lib", "access": "read-write" }, { "path": "/path/to/docs", "access": "read-only" } ] } } } ``` 文件可以手动编辑（改完需重启）。如果文件损坏，插件会拒绝加载并在日志中指出文件路径，而不会用空列表覆盖它。 ## 限制 - 额外目录按**工作区**生效（以会话创建时的工作区目录为准），不是单个会话。 - `@` 文件引用补全、技能发现仍只看工作区目录本身；需要时请让模型用绝对路径访问额外目录。 - DSH 自带的 AGENTS.md 读取只看工作区目录。额外目录的指令文件需开启 `loadInstructions`，且只读取额外目录根部的一个文件：子目录中的 `AGENTS.md`、以及 `AGENTS.local.md` / `CLAUDE.local.md` 本地覆盖文件都不会读取；内容放在运行时上下文中，不会像工作区指令那样按目录逐级合并。 - 如果某个额外目录恰好是工作区的上级目录（例如项目根），DSH 自身可能已经读取了它的 `AGENTS.md`，开启 `loadInstructions` 后同一内容会出现两次。 - 只有 `write` / `edit` 工具的写入会被自动批准；终端命令写入需要确认。 - 没有挂载任何目录选择器的组合里不会显示「选择文件夹…」，此时直接输入路径即可。 - 在还没有发送过消息的新会话里执行 `/dirs` 等命令，结果不会显示在空白首页上（命令已执行并记录在会话日志中）；用输入框旁的按钮查看更直观。 ## 开发 ```bash npm run typecheck # TypeScript 检查 npm test # 单元测试（vitest） npm run build # 生成 lib/index.js（Host）与 lib/client.js（Web 客户端） npm run check # 以上三项 ``` `lib/` 会被提交到仓库（供 `github:` 安装直接使用），修改源码后请运行 `npm run check` 并一起提交 `lib/`。 端到端冒烟测试：用真实的 `dsh --profile headless` 和 DSH 自带的 LLM mock（无需 API key），在临时 `DSH_HOME` 中验证上下文注入、`loadInstructions: true` 时首个模型请求带上额外目录的指令（且默认不带）、读写目录的自动批准、只读目录不批准、以及不装插件时写入被拒绝： ```bash node scripts/smoke-headless.mts /@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js /packages/test-support/llm-mock-server/src/index.ts ``` 需要 Node ≥ 22.19 和 `zstd` 命令行工具。 ### 结构 | 文件 | 作用 | |---|---| | `src/index.ts` | 插件入口：挂载上下文、自动批准、命令、路由（所有 Host 服务均为可选） | | `src/folders.ts` | 生效目录计算、校验、写入授权判断、模型上下文文本 | | `src/instructions.ts` | 读取额外目录根部的 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`，生成有字节上限的指令上下文 | | `src/approval.ts` | 跟踪提权的 `write`/`edit` 调用，应答匹配的审批请求 | | `src/commands.ts` | `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` | | `src/routes.ts` | `/api/workspace-folders/{state,save,pick,browse,resolve}` | | `src/store.ts` | JSON 存储（原子写入、按顺序串行） | | `src/client/index.tsx` | 输入框按钮与对话框 | ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-summarizes a Bilibili video when you send nothing but its link
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bilibili-video-summary

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的插件：
**在对话里只发一条 B 站视频链接、不提任何要求时，自动开始总结这个视频。**

不是把链接丢给模型让它猜，而是先把视频变成可总结的素材——逐段时间轴转写稿 + 关键帧拼图——
再按一套固定的方法论产出总结。画面和文字互相校正，避免语音识别把人名、型号、数字说错。

## 装上之后是什么体验

> 你：`https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411c7mD/`
>
> 助手：（自动取素材、读拼图通读画面、回读关键帧核对参数）→ 直接给出一份结论先行的中文总结。

用户明确说了要干什么时（例如「总结这个」「讲了什么」「帮我翻译」），按用户的说法来，
插件不会抢着注入自己的流程。

## 它解决的问题

直接把视频链接给大模型，通常只能得到三种结果：复述标题、复述简介、或者编。原因是模型拿不到视频内容。
这个插件补上两样东西：

1. **转写稿**——优先用 UP 主自己上传的字幕；没有的话用语音识别，带时间轴，可回查原话。
2. **画面**——按固定间隔抽关键帧，再拼成 16 格「接触印相纸」。一份 20 分钟的视频，
   逐张读图要 190 次以上，读拼图只要 12 次左右，全片结构一眼看完，具体参数再回读单帧核对。

## 安装

需要先有 DSH。本插件按 DSH bundle 规范打包，装完即用：

```bash
# 从 npm 安装
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bilibili-video-summary

# 本地开发：直接指向本目录
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/绝对路径/dsh-bilibili-video-summary
```

装好后重启 DSH，插件会同时注册一个工具（`video_material`）和一个 skill（`bilibili-video-summary`）。

## 外部依赖

视频下载和转码依赖两个命令行工具，语音转写可选装一个 Python 包——**插件会自己找，找不到时会给出安装提示**：

| 依赖 | 用途 | 缺失影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) | 下载视频/音频、抓站方字幕 | 完全不可用 |
| [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)（含 ffprobe） | 抽帧、分离音轨 | 只能拿转写稿，没有画面 |
| [faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper)（可选） | 没有站方字幕时做语音转写 | 退回到「只有画面素材」 |

转写引擎按三级回退自动找，**默认不需要你配置**：

1. **站方字幕** —— UP 主自己上传的字幕，最准也最快，有就直接用。
2. **本机 faster-whisper** —— 装了 `pip install faster-whisper` 就自动探测（连同模型缓存目录一起找），
   默认 `small` 模型、CPU、`int8`。20 分钟视频大约 2 分钟出稿。
3. **自定义命令** —— 设环境变量 `VIDEOSUM_ASR_CMD` 指向任何「音频 → 带时间戳文本」的命令，
   `{audio}` 替换成音频文件路径、`{out}` 替换成输出 txt 路径。适合已经装了别的引擎的人。
   插件自带一份调用脚本，可以照它的参数写：

   ```bash
   # 例：用自带脚本换更大的模型（参数：--audio --out --model --lang --beam-size）
   VIDEOSUM_ASR_CMD=python <插件目录>/lib/asr/faster_whisper_asr.py --audio {audio} --out {out} --model medium
   ```

三者都没有时，插件仍会产出全部画面素材，只是缺少逐字内容——总结照做，细节靠画面核对。
`node lib/video-material.mjs doctor` 会显示当前实际命中的是哪一级。

在 Windows 上，DSH 里跑的命令可能拿不到你交互式 shell 的 PATH。若插件报找不到工具，
用环境变量显式指定即可：

```bash
VIDEOSUM_YTDLP=D:\path\to\yt-dlp.exe
VIDEOSUM_FFMPEG=D:\path\to\ffmpeg.exe
VIDEOSUM_FFPROBE=D:\path\to\ffprobe.exe
```

### 只有 yt_dlp 模块、没有 yt-dlp 可执行文件

如果 yt-dlp 是作为一个 Python 包放在某个目录里（而不是装在解释器的 site-packages），
把它所在目录加进来，插件就会用 `python -m yt_dlp` 调用：

```bash
VIDEOSUM_PYLIBS=D:\path\to\dir-containing-yt_dlp
```

这一点特别值得留意：**文件存在不等于能用**。`yt_dlp` 目录躺在那里但不在
`PYTHONPATH` 里时，`import yt_dlp` 会报 `No module named yt_dlp`。所以插件对每个候选
都真的跑一次 `--version` 验证，`doctor` 报出来的版本号就是实测结果。

## 用法

大多数时候不用管——贴链接就行。也可以显式用它：

- **模型侧工具**：`video_material({ action: "probe", url })` 先看是不是目标视频；
  `video_material({ action: "material", url, every: 3 })` 准备全部素材。
- **命令行**（不经过模型，手动跑素材流水线）：

  ```bash
  node lib/video-material.mjs doctor              # 检查 yt-dlp / ffmpeg / 转写引擎是否就绪（会显示命中哪一级）
  node lib/video-material.mjs probe    --url <URL>
  node lib/video-material.mjs material --url <URL> --every 3
  ```

### 产物

默认输出到 `./vidsum_out/<视频标题>/`：

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `meta.json` | 标题、作者、时长、播放量、简介、章节 |
| `transcript.txt` | `[起-止] 文本` 逐段时间轴转写 |
| `transcript.srt` | 同名 SRT 字幕，可当字幕文件用 |
| `frames/f_*.jpg` | 关键帧单张（默认宽 640） |
| `frames_index.txt` | 单帧 ↔ 时间点对照 |
| `sheets/sheet_*.jpg` | 4×4 关键帧拼图 |
| `sheets_index.txt` | 拼图每格 ↔ 时间点对照 |

### 参数

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--every` | 3 | 抽帧间隔秒。演示类调小（1～2），口播访谈调大（5～10） |
| `--width` | 640 | 关键帧宽度。读取耗时主要看像素数，640 宽约为 960 宽的一半，字幕仍可辨认 |
| `--max-frames` | 192 | 上限；视频过长时插件会自动放宽间隔以覆盖全片 |
| `--grid` / `--cell` | 4x4 / 384 | 拼图布局与每格宽度 |
| `--audio-only` | 关 | 只下音频，省流量 |
| `--no-sheets` / `--no-asr` | 关 | 跳过拼图 / 跳过转写 |

## 总结方法论

插件的 skill 里固化了这几条（也是它比「让模型自己看着办」稳定的原因）：

1. **先给一句话结论**，再展开。细节堆太多会把主线埋掉——用户看不懂通常不是因为信息不够。
2. **两遍法读画面**：先读拼图通读全片，再回读关键帧核对具体参数。
3. **语音识别结果不可全信**：型号、人名、数字一律回画面核对；核对不到就标存疑，不假装确定。
4. **静止文档类视频以画面文字为准**，实拍类视频以讲述为准、画面用来确认型号与数据。
5. **不添加视频里没有的信息**，争议内容标明是作者观点；对线类视频说明这是单方面说法。

## 常见故障

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `No module named yt_dlp` | yt-dlp 以 Python 模块形式存在，但不在 `PYTHONPATH` 里 | 设 `VIDEOSUM_PYLIBS` 指向含 `yt_dlp` 的目录 |
| `HTTP Error 412` | 没有 cookies，B 站拒绝 | 放好 `cookies/bilibili.txt` |
| `HTTP Error 567 Unknown Status` | 媒体下载走了**连不上 B 站 CDN 的本地代理** | 见下 |
| `PermissionError` 指向 cookie 文件 | cookie 文件在只读位置，yt-dlp 退出时回写失败 | 插件已自动复制到可写位置；若仍出现，把 cookie 放到可写目录 |

`567` 这个坑最值得说，因为它的报错完全看不出原因。yt-dlp 会读系统代理设置，
如果本机有个代理（例如 `127.0.0.1:7890`）而它连不通 B 站 CDN，每一个媒体分片
都会被判成 `567`；此时 `--simulate` 解析直链是**正常**的，只有真正传数据才失败，
所以很容易误判成限流或权限问题。

插件对 B 站域名自动追加 `NO_PROXY`（`bilibili.com`、`bilivideo.com`、`hdslb.com`、`b23.tv`），
其他站点仍走你原有的代理设置。如果你手动调 yt-dlp 也遇到，加 `--proxy ""` 即可。

## 已知限制

- B 站高画质与部分字幕需要登录。插件会自动读取工作区 `cookies/bilibili.txt`（Netscape 格式）
  或 `--cookies` 指定的文件。Cookie 会过期，过期后请重新导出。
- 转写质量取决于 ASR 引擎与音质；本插件不改善识别本身，只保证错误能被画面校正。
- 只对**用户消息里只有链接**的情况自动触发。如果同时贴了多条链接，只会总结第一条——
  想让插件逐条处理，直说即可。
- 抽帧是等间隔的，不是「智能选帧」。全屏 PPT 或长时间静止画面会有大量重复帧。
- 索引文件（`frames_index.txt`、`sheets_index.txt`）的表头是 **ASCII**，这是刻意的：
  按 GBK 解码中文会把表头变成乱码，而这些索引正是用来看时间点的。

## 开源协议

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）用的 agent 技能集（skills）：记忆档案维护、本机操作规矩、插件发布规程、Web 健康检查、会话日志修复。每个技能一个 SKILL.md。MIT。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-skills

给 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 用的 agent 技能集：每个技能是一份 `SKILL.md`，写清某类任务的操作规矩（触发时机、步骤、边界、踩过的坑），DSH 会在会话里按需加载。

目录约定：

```
skills/<name>/SKILL.md
```

## 技能一览

| 技能 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `agent-diary` | 维护「日记／状态／生长记录／APP 版」这套档案，以及处理会话交接包时的规矩。 |
| `agent-lookup` | 查资料、找文件、判读用户发的截图时的规矩：先搜再看来源、外部内容只当数据。 |
| `agent-machine` | 改本机插件、跑设备命令、动文件系统时的通用规矩：先备份、分开验证据、改完等重启、被拒就停。 |
| `dsh-plugin-publish` | 把本机插件发布/更新到 GitHub 之前的规矩：能推什么、私密信息清单、怎么脱敏、推完怎么自查。 |
| `dsh-web-healthcheck` | DSH Web GUI 健康检查与「界面无反应」类问题诊断：全链路自检顺序与判定流程。 |
| `session-log-repair` | 修复 DSH 会话历史日志损坏（seq 空洞、历史打不开）的检测、备份、分析、重建、验证流程。 |

## 用法

把某个技能目录整个放进 DSH 的技能目录（例如 `~/.agents/skills/<name>/`），或者把 `SKILL.md` 的内容并进你自己的技能配置。技能里出现的命令、路径与端口请按自己机器的实际情况替换。

## 许可

MIT License。技能文本按原样提供，不含任何保证；执行其中命令前请自行确认目标环境。

plugins.description: Background-first macOS cross-application desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness, with hidden agent cursor and post-action observations.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Computer Use Next

macOS 全局跨应用桌面控制插件。默认隐藏虚拟光标，在后台选定窗口；窗口操作后自动回读界面，供 DSH 模型继续判断。

基于 MIT 授权的 [dsh-computer-use 0.3.1](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-computer-use) 修改，保留原许可，变更见 NOTICE。本项目与 OpenAI、Codex 无隶属关系，不包含其内部实现或模型。

## 要求

- macOS；其他操作系统未验证。
- Node.js 22.18+；兼容 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.0-rc.2 接口的 DSH 宿主。
- 已安装 CuaDriver，并授予其辅助功能和屏幕录制权限；实测版本 0.35.2。
- 原生图片和整屏观察需要对话模型支持图片输入，否则使用窗口 AX 控件树。

## 安装

发布后可通过 GitHub Release 中的 dsh-computer-use-next.tgz 安装，或由收录后的 DSH 插件市场安装。仓库自带 dsh.bundle manifest 和运行时 JavaScript，不需要编译。

本机桌面 profile 的手动安装：

```sh
python3 install.py
```

脚本只针对已有 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop 的桌面版，复制插件、备份并追加配置，不重启应用、不更改模型账号。其他 profile 使用宿主的插件安装方式。

如已启用旧版 dsh-computer-use，先禁用旧版，避免同名工具重复注册；本插件不会擅自禁用其他插件。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| desktop_windows | 全局应用窗口列表及精确窗口 ID。 |
| app_switch | 后台选定并观察目标窗口，不主动前置。 |
| desktop_observe | 主显示器整屏图片，包括 Dock 和菜单栏。 |
| desktop_click | 全局坐标点击及回读；后台模式默认禁用。 |
| screen_observe | 窗口 AX 控件树及可用截图。 |
| screen_zoom | 局部截图。 |
| computer_click / computer_double_click / computer_right_click | 窗口点击、双击、右键。 |
| computer_type / computer_key | 目标窗口文本输入及快捷键。 |
| computer_scroll / computer_drag | 窗口内滚动及拖拽。 |
| computer_wait | 等待加载。 |
| app_list / app_launch | 应用列表及启动。 |

合计 16 个工具。窗口点击、输入、按键、滚动和拖拽后自动回读原窗口，模型需要检查实际变化。不同 agent 的观察缓存隔离，插件内调用串行执行。

示例：

> 使用 desktop_windows 查看窗口，选定计算器计算 12+34，再观察另一个应用，最后回到计算器核对结果。保持后台，每步检查界面，不重复执行结果未知的动作。

## 后台与前台

默认 backgroundOnly=true、animateCursor=false。驱动会话初始化和恢复时关闭虚拟光标，不隐藏用户自己的鼠标。

后台模式禁止主动前置及 desktop_click；使用 app_launch 和 app_switch 跨应用工作。不支持后台的操作会失败，不自动前置重试；应用自身弹窗仍可能改变焦点，不能保证所有软件完全后台运行。

如需 Dock/菜单栏点击，可显式设置 backgroundOnly=false，允许前台交互。整屏坐标和窗口坐标不能混用。

未验证多屏、其他 Space、最小化窗口及完整模型驱动的跨应用长任务；未实现跨窗口拖拽、视频流或独立无人值守规划。

## 数据和权限

截图经 DSH attachments 服务处理，可能按模型路由发送给模型服务商。显式 vision 模式继承上游观察者及可选 GLM fallback，其密钥查找和请求见 lib/vision.js。默认 native/AX 路径不新增密钥。

快照 TTL、应用白名单和部分按钮审批规则不是完整安全保障，坐标点击及快捷键不能可靠推断业务后果。详见 PERMISSIONS.md。

## 验证和卸载

```sh
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
python3 install.py --uninstall
```

16 项自动测试通过。实际验证了计算器点击与截图回读、计算器与 DSH 的后台窗口观察、1568×1014 整屏读取及虚拟光标关闭。完整模型任务尚未验证。

卸载只移除本插件的配置块，保留其他配置及插件文件。下一次启动或宿主重新加载配置后生效。

plugins.description: A Kanban board for DSH: one SQLite board shared by a human and their agent sessions, in the desktop app's sidebar. Two gates (Definition of Ready, Definition of Done) are enforced by the board itself, and every move is an event, so cycle time and throughput come from what happened.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-kanban

One task board for the whole home directory, shared by Dhira and by every agent session: the panel is
the human's view, the `kanban_*` tools are the agents', and `bin/kanban.mjs` is the scripted one — all
over one SQLite store, through one policy engine, so **the gate that refuses an agent is the gate that
refuses the human**.

| surface | who uses it | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Kanban panel** (`sidebar.panellist` → `main`) | the human | every state as a lane (`dropped` last), drag-and-drop with a keyboard path, a search box, a `New card` button that opens a minimal create dialog, the card drawer with both checklists, the flow metrics and a collapsible history |
| **`kanban_*` tools** (9) and the `kanban` skill | agents | list, read, create, update/fill, move, drop, sprint, board, metrics — including the card's write scope |
| **`bin/kanban.mjs`** | the human, scripts, checks | the same verbs from a shell, with distinct exit codes |

## Why

Task state used to live in a hand-authored Markdown table and in whatever each session remembered,
and no surface could be trusted to agree with another: nothing enforced a gate, and nothing recorded
that a move had happened. The figures were the giveaway. An import stamped
`started_at = finished_at = now` on eleven migrated cards, and the generated view advertised

> Throughput 11 in 7 days · Cycle time median 0d · SLE … (history, from 11 finished)

while the event log held two moves. A board that asserts history it does not have is worse than no
board, because the number is read as evidence.

`dsh-kanban` replaces that with one SQLite store below all three surfaces and one policy engine above
it, at `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db`. The gates — Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, WIP limits,
priority and class of service — live in the store; every mutation appends an event. The store is the
only copy: the Markdown mirror and the per-card folder tree it once rendered are gone. The four flow
metrics are recomputed from what happened rather than read off a column.

## Agent Skills

The host half registers the **`kanban`** skill at runtime, so an agent session can work a card without
reading this source: list and read the board, create a card, refine it until the Definition of Ready
is ticked, move it through the gates, comment, block and unblock — and be refused with the names of
the items that are missing. The skill carries the DoR/DoD item names and the rule that a write scope
is data the agent must pass.

## Quick Start

The plugin lives inside the profile it serves, so "install" means *register it and restart the app*.
Either route ends the same way: a `link:` dependency, a bundle row, and a restart.

### Option A — the script

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-kanban
./install.sh            # registers the bundle in the profile and links it
./install.sh --check    # what would change
./install.sh --remove   # unregister
```

### Option B — by hand

1. **Clone it to a stable path** — the path becomes the install path.
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-kanban.git ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-kanban
   ```
2. **`pnpm install`** — this plugin's own toolchain, not the profile's. Its `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
   allows esbuild's build script, which pnpm 11 blocks by default. The `prepare` script runs
   `node build.mjs`, which writes `lib/**` (the host half, the store and the client half) and
   `bin/kanban.mjs` — what `main` and the bundle point at.
3. **Register the dependency *and* the bundle name** in the profile's `package.json`
   (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`):
   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": { "dsh-kanban": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-kanban" },
     "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-kanban"] } }
   }
   ```
4. **Install the profile link, then restart DSH** — `pnpm install` in the profile directory creates
   `node_modules/dsh-kanban`, the symlink the Loader resolves the package name through. A new bundle
   row is a composition change, so **a host-half change needs an app restart**. A client-half change
   needs only a page reload: the Loader picks up a new bundle row by itself, but a module inside a row
   that is already loaded does not reload (T-008).

### Configure

A fresh install needs **nothing**: the board defaults to `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` (its parent is
created on first open), and the Definition of Workflow ships with the guide's limits. The
bundle row is created with an empty `config` on purpose — Cordis validates a row's config before the
plugin activates, and the host half exports no schema to validate against, so it reads every field
defensively and applies its own defaults.

| setting | default | effect |
|---|---|---|
| `dbPath` | `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` | where the board's SQLite file lives |
| `pollMs` | `5000` | the panel's refresh interval while it is visible |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: kanban
      name: dsh-kanban
      config:
        dbPath: /absolute/path/board.db
        pollMs: 5000
```

A field the patch does not mention keeps the default above, so declare only what you mean to change.

## How it Works

Three surfaces read and write **one** store through **one** policy engine: a rule enforced in the
panel is enforced in the tools and the CLI, because there is only one implementation of it. The board
is `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` (SQLite), and its history is the append-only `events` table — one row
per mutation. It is the only copy: no Markdown view and no folder tree, so never hand-edit it.

A profile plugin **cannot import anything but Node builtins** (`@deepseek-ai/*` does not resolve from
a profile directory). That is why the DSH contracts are vendored in `src/types/dsh.ts`, the store is
our own SQLite, and the browser half talks to the host over this plugin's own HTTP route rather than a
typed Remote. `DESIGN.md` is the full design record and `PRODUCT.md` the product brief.

`/api/kanban` serves `health`, `board` (with `?since=<rev>` → `304`), `task/:id`, and `POST mutate`
with an op. The route is registered as a prefix on the app's own web server, so it wins
the longest-prefix match over the app's `/api` bridge and therefore **does not carry that bridge's
browser-session fence**: a request from this machine is believed, including an
`x-kanban-actor: human`. The server binds loopback only.

That is a deliberate, recorded trade for a single-user local tool. The boundary that matters — an
agent may not set a priority — is enforced at the *tool* boundary, where an agent's identity is its
session and not a header it can choose. A per-launch token is the obvious hardening and is deferred
until the index-injection question for a `file://`-loaded window is answered.

### What it looks like

The board, six lanes and every state reachable, in the app's own two themes. Nothing is styled against
the app: every colour is one of its theme tokens with a literal fallback.

| light | dark |
|---|---|
| ![The board in the light theme](docs/screenshots/board-light.png) | ![The board in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/board-dark.png) |

A card's drawer: one primary move, the rest behind a disclosure, the Definition of Ready as checkable
rows, and the history collapsed until asked for.

| light | dark |
|---|---|
| ![A card's drawer in the light theme](docs/screenshots/drawer-light.png) | ![A card's drawer in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/drawer-dark.png) |

### The flow

A card moves through five states, and two gates decide whether it may. `dropped` is off the workflow —
it is where a card goes when it leaves, and the way back is the drawer's own primary move.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  B[backlog] -->|"DoR complete"| R[ready]
  R --> I[in-progress]
  I --> V[review]
  V -->|"DoD complete"| D[done]
  B -.->|"dropped, with a reason"| X[dropped]
  R -.-> X
  I -.-> X
  V -.-> X
  X -->|"the drawer's move"| B
```

- **Definition of Ready** — outcome, acceptance, write scope, estimate. A card in `backlog` cannot be
  pulled into `ready` until every item is ticked, and the refusal names the ones that are missing.
- **Definition of Done** — evidence, tests, docs, links, and no unverified

plugins.description: Codex-style Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation + screenshots + SendInput, liquid-glass screen overlay, ESC kill switch. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/esch30636/dsh-computer-use?sort=semver)](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B5563)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and backed by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.

While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look: a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) with a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent is told to stop and reports back.

Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `click(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin with no third-party runtime dependencies.

## What you get

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, rect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `computer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with element indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_click / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitive GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |

Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe` — pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `systemPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm dependencies, no MCP server.

## Install

### Option A — DSH CLI (`dsh plugin add`)

For profiles the `dsh` CLI can manage (`web`, `tui`, `headless`, …), the plugin
installs as a regular DSH bundle:

```sh
# straight from GitHub (pnpm fetches the repo tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use

# or from the release tarball (no git fetch; works behind a GitHub proxy too)
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest/download/dsh-computer-use.tgz"
```

`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle.
Restart the host (or let HMR recompose) and the `computer_*` tools appear in a
new session.

### Option B — Desktop app (`desktop` profile)

The Desktop app owns its reserved `desktop` profile, so `dsh plugin --profile
desktop` deliberately refuses to run there. Two supported paths:

1. **Plugin market** — after this plugin is listed in
   [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) (submission pending the
   one-day repository age rule), open **设置 → 插件市场** and install it with one
   click.
2. **Release installer** (works immediately, no git/pnpm needed): download and
   unzip the archive from
   [releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases), then run
   inside the unzipped folder:

   ```powershell
   # downloads the latest release tarball and installs into the desktop profile
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-release.ps1
   ```

   Pin a version with `-Version v1.1.0`; target another profile with
   `-Profile web`; add `-Verify` to run the offline composition dump afterwards.

### Option C — manual / fully offline

Download the release archive
([releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)), unzip it,
then run the bundled installer:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

The installer copies the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-computer-use`, appends `dsh-computer-use` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (backing up `package.json`), and installs the skill to `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\computer-use`. It works for any profile, e.g. `-Profile cu-test`, and `-Verify` dumps the composed profile offline.

Uninstall:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

> **Note on the package name:** an unrelated npm package already uses the name
> `dsh-computer-use`, so `dsh plugin add dsh-computer-use` would install that one.
> Install this plugin through the GitHub spec or the release tarball URL shown
> above. Windows-only (`os: win32`): the helper drives a real interactive desktop
> session via UI Automation + SendInput.

## Configure

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the row id is `computer-use`):

```yaml
- id: computer-use
  config:
    # extra process names/paths to deny (built-in denies always stay unless an
    # allow-* escape hatch is enabled)
    blockedProcesses: [msedge.exe]
    # allowlist mode: only these processes may be automated
    # allowedProcesses: [notepad.exe, mspaint.exe]
    screenshotMaxWidth: 1600
    screenshotMaxHeight: 1200
    maxElements: 600
    maxTreeDepth: 12
    idleTimeoutMs: 600000
    startupTimeoutMs: 90000
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    confirmRiskyActions: true
    warnWhenApprovalUnavailable: true
    allowWindowsKey: false
    allowTerminalAutomation: false
    keepScreenshots: false
    # screen overlay + ESC kill switch
    overlayEnabled: true
    overlayMessage: "DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑　|　按 ESC 终止"
    overlayIdleTimeoutMs: 90000
    overlayEdgeOpacity: 55
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |
| `keepScreenshots` | `false` | Keep captured PNGs in `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use` for debugging. |
| `confirmRiskyActions` | `true` | Ask through `ctx.approval` before destructive/externally visible actions. |
| `warnWhenApprovalUnavailable` | `true` | Under approval policy `never`/no channel: continue with a WARNING instead of failing. Set false for fail-closed. |
| `allowWindowsKey` / `allowTerminalAutomation` | `false` | Escape hatches for the two most dangerous hard denies (still discouraged; the helper keeps its own che

plugins.description: Unofficial visual control panel and MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: model, workspace and permission controls, task monitoring, and reusable sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-bridge

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**A visible control panel for Claude Code and Codex delegation to DeepSeek Harness.** Choose the model, provider, workspace, and new-session permissions in Harness; inspect task state through MCP; find and continue the resulting conversations.

This project is for people who want to spend less of their main model's effort on bounded supporting tasks, and make repeated Harness calls and the resulting sessions easier to manage.

> Third-party, unofficial integration. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek, Anthropic, or OpenAI. Harness interfaces and MCP clients can change; check the compatibility notes before upgrading.

> **Archive-only maintenance in 0.2.4:** permanent deletion is disabled in every plugin entry point. The compatible `autoCleanupDays` setting now archives eligible MCP-created sessions, keeps their files, and uses the official non-stopping option; `0` turns automatic archival off. Old pending-delete files are retained unchanged and never executed. See [maintenance boundaries and upgrade notes](docs/troubleshooting.md#cleanup-limitation-and-pending-deletions).

## Why this bridge?

- **Delegate selectively.** Send a narrow review, summary, documentation task, or investigation to Harness, then bring the result back to your main agent.
- **Keep responsibility clear.** The main agent still scopes the task, checks the result, and integrates useful work.
- **Keep controls visible.** Use Harness's toolbar for task constraints and its conversations for context; use MCP status/results to inspect execution rather than relying on a silent handoff.
- **Manage repeated delegation.** Find task IDs after a disconnect, continue managed sessions, and archive conversations you want to keep.

Delegation can reduce the amount of work the main model performs, but it does not guarantee a fixed quota reduction, lower total cost, or faster completion. DeepSeek or your chosen provider can still charge for delegated work, and coordination, retries, and review still consume resources. See [choosing and measuring delegated tasks](docs/delegation.md).

## How it fits together

1. Claude Code, Codex, or another compatible MCP client sends a tool request.
2. The local bridge connects that request to the plugin running in DeepSeek Harness.
3. A Harness agent uses the configured provider, workspace, and execution permissions.
4. The client receives the task result for review and further work.

**A local bridge does not mean local model inference.** Prompts and relevant workspace content may be sent to the provider configured in Harness. Check your provider's terms and your own data-sharing permissions before delegating private material.

The current plugin installs into the **desktop profile**, so that Harness host must be running. This is a good fit if you already use Harness and delegate frequently. A one-off task may not justify the extra installation and process. Harness also has an official CLI; other hosting profiles for this plugin have not been verified. [CLI and hosting FAQ](docs/troubleshooting.md#does-harness-have-a-cli).

## Quick start

Bridge version: **0.2.4**. Target Harness desktop version: **0.2.1-rc.2**. Build with Node.js **22+** and npm. Maintainer-provided verification notes cover Windows; they do not establish support for every platform or MCP client.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/FishCityBee/dsh-mcp-bridge.git
cd dsh-mcp-bridge
npm ci
npm run build
```

Install `dist-package/` with Harness's bundled CLI. Windows PowerShell example, with paths replaced for your installation:

```powershell
& "D:\Program Files\Deepseek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-mcp-bridge\dist-package"
```

Completely quit Harness, including the tray process, and reopen it. In the bridge toolbar, select your provider/model, a disposable default workspace, and read-only new-session permissions. Automatic archival defaults to off; enable it only after reviewing its scope.

Register the relay in the client you use, with its absolute path:

```sh
# Claude Code
claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user dsh-harness -- node "C:/path/to/dsh-mcp-bridge/dist-package/bin/stdio.mjs"

# Codex
codex mcp add dsh-harness -- node "C:/path/to/dsh-mcp-bridge/dist-package/bin/stdio.mjs"
```

Ask the client to call `harness_status`, `list_models`, and `list_workspaces` before starting a task. Then try one small task with no file changes. Model tasks can incur provider charges. See [installation, timeouts, environment variables, and upgrade steps](docs/installation.md) for complete instructions and official client references.

## Controls that matter

- **Model constraints:** single-model mode locks provider/model/effort. Provider mode also locks model/effort unless the user enables caller overrides; the provider stays locked.
- **Execution evidence:** requested and effective model selections are separate. `effectiveSelection` is populated only after the bridge observes a request, and does not prove provider acceptance or billing.
- **Permissions:** new-session presets use Harness's official permission service; that selector leaves existing sessions unchanged. Full access is a high-risk option, not a setup requirement.
- **Task lifecycle:** start, wait, inspect, find, and cancel tasks. Client disconnects are separate from task cancellation; cancellation cannot undo completed effects.
- **Sessions:** continue bridge-managed conversations and archive/unarchive them. Automatic maintenance only archives; permanent deletion is unavailable.

The default connection uses a local pipe/socket with the stdio relay, without opening a TCP port. Optional HTTP is off by default. Update the plugin and the entire relay together; 0.2.4 uses `tls-pinned-v3` and does not fall back to older handshakes.

## Documentation

- [Installation and Claude Code / Codex setup](docs/installation.md)
- [Configuration, model defaults, and permission boundaries](docs/configuration.md)
- [Tool reference, task recovery, and session maintenance](docs/usage.md)
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Delegating useful work](docs/delegation.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security and responsible reporting](SECURITY.md)

## Permission boundaries

There are two separate decisions: whether your MCP client may call a bridge tool, and whether the Harness agent may perform an operation. Client-side MCP approval is not a replacement for Harness execution approval. Choosing a workspace does not by itself sandbox an agent.

Start in a disposable workspace with a small, read-only task. Keep credentials out of prompts, screenshots, and issue reports. Review substantive results before accepting changes. Back up important session data. Plugin deletion stays disabled until an official safe cross-process deletion boundary is available.

## Compatibility and verification

This bridge relies on version-specific Harness APIs and storage behavior. Other Harness versions, alternate profiles, and all client/platform combinations are not implied to be supported.

The repository includes maintainer-written technical records in Chinese: [reliability changes](docs/audit-2026-10-17.md), [desktop transport checks](docs/desktop-2026-10-18.md), and [new-session permission checks](docs/ui-permissions-2026-10-18.md). The [0.2.4 maintenance notes](docs/recheck-0.2.4.md) distinguish the current changes from earlier historical reports. Their stated test scope and remaining gaps matter; they are not a claim that all security risks or UI paths have been validated.

## Contribute

Bug reports, compatibility checks, translations, and focused pull requests are welcome in English or Chinese. Please read the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), and keep secrets and private session content out of public reports.

If this project helps your workflow, a star helps others discover it.

# dsh-rea-toggle

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

One switch per conversation that decides whether the **REA**
(`reverse-engineer-anything`) MCP server's context reaches the model at all.

REA registers **207 tool schemas** plus a multi-kilobyte server-instructions
block. `dsh-mcp-client` puts both on the **global** layer, so every agent pays
for them on every request — whether or not the turn has anything to do with
reverse engineering.

With this plugin installed, a small pill appears below the composer:

- **REA on** (green) — exactly the pre-install behaviour. REA's tools and
  instructions are visible to the model.
- **REA off** (grey) — those 207 tool schemas and the `mcp:rea` instructions
  block **leave the model context**, taking effect on the next step.

**The switch is per conversation.** Each conversation remembers its own
position, and a new conversation starts **off**. That is the whole point: a
conversation about a web app should not pay for 207 reverse-engineering schemas
just because some other conversation needs them. Subagents inherit the position
of the conversation that created them, so delegating inside reverse-engineering
work does not silently break the subagent.

The same switch is on the keyboard: `/rea off`, `/rea on`, `/rea status`,
`/rea toggle` — all acting on the conversation you typed them in.

Nothing is uninstalled and nothing restarts. The MCP connection stays up; the
model simply stops being told those tools exist.

---

## English

### What it actually does

The token cost comes from two different places that travel two different paths,
so one mechanism is not enough:

| Target | Mechanism |
| --- | --- |
| Tool schemas | `tools.restrict({ deny })` is called **in each agent's own context**. `ToolRuntime.view()` filters what that scope *inherits* from the global layer, and the model-facing schema list is rebuilt from that view on every assembly. The reserved `run_code` transport sits outside the filterable layers, so it is unaffected. |
| Instructions text | `dsh-mcp-client` registers the server instructions as a prompt section named `mcp:<server>` at order `MCP_SERVERS` (3100). **A scoped section with the same name shadows the global one** — a documented contract of `systemPrompt.section()` ("a scoped section shadows a global section with the same name"), not an implementation detail — and an empty section is dropped at render (`renderPrompt` keeps only `text.length > 0`). Registering that name and returning `''` therefore removes the block for that agent alone. |

Both are scoped registrations, so disposing them restores the previous state
exactly. That is why flipping the switch needs no restart and no reload.

Coverage includes **subagents**: `agent/created` is serial and awaited by the
registry, so installing inside it lands ahead of any prompt assembly.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:aurumple/dsh-rea-toggle
```

Or point at a checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-rea-toggle
```

The bundle row id is `rea-toggle`; the package name is `dsh-rea-toggle`.

### Use

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| Pill under the composer | Click to flip **this conversation**. Green = on, grey = off, red border = the host did not answer. |
| `/rea off` · `/rea on` | Set this conversation's position. `enable` / `disable` work too. |
| `/rea toggle` | Flip this conversation. |
| `/rea status` | Report this conversation's position. |

A new conversation starts off. The first time you turn one on, that conversation
is remembered; conversations you never touch stay on the default and are not
written down.

Positions are remembered in `$DSH_HOME/rea-toggle.json` (usually
`~/.dsh/rea-toggle.json`), keyed by session id, and survive a restart. The file
keeps the 500 most recently changed conversations; an older one simply falls
back to the default.

### Configuration

Every field is optional.

```yaml
- id: rea-toggle
  name: dsh-rea-toggle
  config:
    server: rea               # one MCP server to govern; default "rea"
    # servers: [rea, ghidra]  # or several; wins over `server` when present
    # defaultEnabled: true    # new conversations start ON instead of off
```

Changing `server` governs a different MCP server by the same rules: tool prefix
`mcp__<server>__`, instructions section `mcp:<server>`. Because the mechanism is
generic, this works for any MCP server whose tools are bridged by
`dsh-mcp-client` — the REA case is just the one that motivated it.

`defaultEnabled` exists for anyone who wants the pre-plugin behaviour back: with
it on, a conversation nobody has switched behaves exactly as if this plugin were
not installed.

### HTTP API

The Client half talks to the Host over one exact route on the bare `webServer`
(the same shape other bundles use, so it does not travel through the `/api`
prefix fence). The conversation is `session=` on GET and a body field on POST:
the pill always knows which conversation it is showing, and a request that does
not say cannot be answered for it.

```
GET  /rea-toggle/state?session=<id>
  -> { session, enabled, known, defaultEnabled, servers, agents, tools, statePath }

GET  /rea-toggle/state            (no session: a summary)
  -> { session: null, defaultEnabled, servers, conversations, agents, tools, statePath }

POST /rea-toggle/state
  body: { "session": "<id>", "enabled": true | false }   (omit `enabled` to flip)
  -> the per-conversation status object
```

`known` says whether this conversation has ever been switched; when it is
`false`, `enabled` is just `defaultEnabled` and nothing has been written yet.
`agents` is how many live agents of that conversation are currently covered;
`tools` is how many of the governed server's tools were recognised, which is the
honest answer to "did it find REA at all" — if it reads `0`, the server is not
connected under that name (and stays `0`-safe because `restrictableNames` is the
denyable set, not the filtered view).

### Scope and limits

- **One server per row by default.** Other MCP servers are untouched; use
  `servers` to govern more than one.
- **Hidden, not unloaded.** The MCP connection stays up and the REA process
  keeps running. When the switch is off the model simply cannot reach it —
  including indirectly through `run_code`. That is deliberate: leaving a second
  path open would save only half the tokens.
- **Per-conversation state, in-process.** Positions are read from the file at
  `apply()` and written on every change. Two DSH instances sharing one profile
  each read it once and do not live-sync with each other.
- **It does not delete anything.** Turning it off is reversible in one click,
  and uninstalling the bundle lifts every registration.

### Verify it yourself

The claim is that the tools are gone from the model's context, not merely
hidden in a UI. Check it where the model's own view is exposed:

1. With the switch **on**, ask the agent to list its tools — `mcp__rea__*`
   entries are there (207 of them for a stock REA install).
2. Turn it **off**, ask again — they are gone, and calling one by name returns
   `Error: unknown tool "mcp__rea__binary_session"`.
3. Turn it back **on** — they return, unchanged.
4. Open a **second conversation** and check its tool list: it is off, while the
   first one is still on. That is the property that distinguishes this plugin
   from a global toggle.

### Development

```bash
npm test        # node:test, no dependencies
```

The suite drives the real `apply()` against a small model of the three
contracts it depends on (tool view, prompt section merge, agent registry). It
pins what "off" removes, that "on" restores the previous state exactly, that a
new subagent is covered before its first step, that the position survives a
restart, and that the HTTP surface validates its input.

### License

MIT

REA 注册了 **207 个工具 schema**，外加一段几千字的服务端说明。

plugins.description: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-failover

DeepSeek Harness 的搜索故障转移插件：按顺序尝试多个搜索后端，前一个失败（HTTP 错误、没有 `web_search_tool_result` 结果块、或返回空结果）时自动落到下一个。

> **English.** A failover web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. The harness resolves exactly one search provider per `ctx.web` seam and a provider carries a single `model`, so one upstream error kills the whole search. This bundle registers a `deepseek-failover` provider that walks an ordered list of backends — same request, next backend on any failure (throw, abort excepted, or an empty result) — and only fails when every backend did. The stock `web-search-deepseek` row is disabled by the bundle's own patch, so no manual profile editing is needed. Node ≥ 22, harness ≥ 0.2.1, MIT.

## 为什么需要它

Harness 的 `ctx.web` 每次只解析一个 search provider，provider 也只有单个 `model` 字段，没有失败重试链；`web-search-deepseek` 一旦上游出错，整次搜索就失败。new-api 的自动换渠道只在“同一个模型名有多个渠道”时生效，所以要么在网关造一个别名，要么在 harness 侧做转移。本插件选后者：网关保持官方模型名。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell 7 或 5.1） | ✅ | `dsh plugin` 本身跨平台；本文所有命令在 PowerShell 里原样可跑 |
| macOS（zsh / bash） | ✅ | 原生路径 |
| Linux | ✅ | 原生路径 |

前置条件：

- **DSH ≥ 0.2.1** — 插件复用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 导出的 `DeepSeekSearchProvider`，0.2.0 没有这个接口
- **Node ≥ 22**，且 **`pnpm` 在 `PATH` 上**（`dsh plugin` 内部调 pnpm）
- 能访问 `https://codeload.github.com`（public 仓库，不需要 token）
- 一个 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容的搜索网关，以及它的 API key

## 安装

一条命令（自动写依赖、写 `dsh.profile.bundles`、并跑 `pnpm install`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

```powershell
# Windows 上完全一样
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后**重启 DSH**（关掉 `dsh web` 的终端再重新起）。插件是在 host 启动时 import 的，不重启不会生效 —— 详见排错第 1 条。

Desktop 版 profile 名是 `desktop`，需要先**完全退出应用**再加：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

插件没有 `prepare` 脚本、没有构建步骤，纯 JS，不会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦截。

### 凭据

插件的 `apiKeyEnv` 指向一个**凭据引用名**，不是明文。把网关令牌写进 harness 的凭据文件：

- macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.credentials.yaml`

```yaml
refs:
  NEWAPI_API_KEY: sk-...
```

这个文件由 harness 的 credentials 插件注入，**不需要写系统环境变量**。如果你更习惯环境变量，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成对应的变量名即可。

### 不想用 CLI 时

手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 效果一样：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-web-search-failover": "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-web-search-failover" ] } }
```

再在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`，Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`）跑 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 "searchProvider"
```

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String -Pattern "searchProvider" -Context 0,3
```

应看到 `searchProvider: deepseek-failover`。再做一次真实搜索，网关日志里会出现主后端的模型名；只有主后端失败时才会多一条备用后端。

**关于默认网关地址**：插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `baseURL` 写的是一个示例网关（`http://43.133.21.227:3000/v1`）。用别人的地址跑不通，**请改成你自己的网关**，见下一节。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `id: web-search-failover` 这一行的 `config`（插件自带的默认顺序是 `deepseek-v4-flash` → `claude-haiku-5-5`，不覆盖就按这个走）：

```yaml
- id: web-search-failover
  config:
    providerId: deepseek-failover   # ctx.web 选中的 provider 名，一般不用改
    backends:
      - { model: deepseek-v4-flash,  baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
      - { model: claude-haiku-5-5,   baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
```

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `deepseek-failover` | 注册给 `ctx.web` 的 provider 名；bundle patch 里 `web.searchProvider` 必须与它一致 |
| `backends` | — | **有序**列表，第 0 个优先，其后都是备胎；每项 `model` / `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` 各自独立 |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `apiVersion` / `maxTokens` / `maxUses` | 见 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config` | 旧式单后端字段；用 `backends` 时不需要，插件按 backend 逐个构造 provider |

失败判定：抛错、或者成功但没有 sources。`WEB_ABORTED`（用户取消）直接向上抛，不换后端 —— 取消不该触发备用后端。全部失败才返回最后一个错误；如果所有后端都成功但确实没结果，返回那个空结果。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后重启 DSH。bundle 的 patch 随之失效，harness 原有的 `web-search-deepseek` 行会恢复；如果你之前手工在 profile patch 里删过它，需要自己加回来。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但搜索行为没变 | 插件在 host 进程启动时 import，进程里的模块不会热替换 | 重启 DSH（关掉 `dsh web` 再起） |
| 改了插件源码（哪怕是 `lib/index.js`）也不生效 | Node 的 ESM 缓存：已 import 的模块不会重新执行 | 同上，重启 host；GitHub 安装还需先 `dsh plugin add` 重装以拉新代码 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或报网络错误 | 拉的是 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball，公司网络/代理常拦 | 走代理，或把仓库整目录拷过去，依赖改成 `file:` 路径后 `pnpm install`（插件无外部 npm 依赖，离线可装） |
| 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 所有 backends 都 `available() === false`，通常是 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的引用没有值 | 检查 `.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里有该键，且键名与 `apiKeyEnv` 完全一致 |
| 搜索一直是备用后端的模型 | 主后端失败但未报错（返回空结果也会触发回落） | 看网关日志确认主后端返回码；密钥额度、模型名拼写是最常见原因 |
| 配置树里出现同一个 row id 冲突（`web-search-deepseek` 被两处同时声明） | profile patch 里手工加过 `id: web-search-deepseek` 的行，与 bundle patch 打架 | 删掉 profile 里那一行，插件自带的 patch 已负责禁用它 |

## 同步到另一台机器

逻辑全在插件里，换机器不需要搬配置，但要满足四件事：

1. **装插件**：跑上面那条 `dsh plugin add`。版本自动跟 `master` 最新提交，两台机器不必同 commit，但 harness 版本要一致（都 ≥ 0.2.1）。
2. **凭据**：`.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里要有 `NEWAPI_API_KEY`。
3. **清掉旧的 provider 行**：profile patch 里若还有 `- id: web-search-deepseek`，删掉。
4. **网关可达**：`baseURL` 换成本机可访问的地址。

## 开发

本仓库是纯 JS、无构建步骤。仓库里没有 `node_modules`，直接 `npm test` 会因为找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 依赖而失败 —— 先把本机已安装的 harness 包链进来：

```bash
node scripts/dev-link.mjs            # 探测 dsh 的安装位置，链入 schemastery / dsh-web / dsh-web-search-deepseek 等
npm test                             # node --test
```

`dev-link` 依次探测：`dsh` 可执行文件所在的 npm 目录、`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`、`$DSH_HOME/profiles`、`$DSH_HOME`，也可以用第一个参数或 `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` 直接指定 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 所在目录。Windows 上用 junction，不需要管理员权限。

改完代码在本地验证，再装到 profile：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>` 走 `link:` 依赖，配合 `dev-link` 即可改完重启 host 就看到效果。

## 相关插件

同作者、同一套安装方式（`dsh plugin add github:xingzoudefengye/<repo>`）：

- [dsh-browser](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-browser) — 给 agent 一个可驱动的真实浏览器，侧栏并排显示
- [dsh-compaction-local-handoff](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff) — 无模型的本地交接式压缩
- [dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory) — 有界、可提交进 git 的项目记忆
- [dsh-resume-budget](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget) — 会话恢复时的输入预算控制
- [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) — 无模型、有界的会话史书

## 许可

MIT © xingzoudefengye，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text: # DeepSeek 价格峰谷提醒 [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip) --- 在 Harness Web UI 的输入框下方显示一个小胶囊，提醒你 DeepSeek 官方 API 当前处于 **峰价** 还是 **谷价**，以及距离下次切换还有多久。点开胶囊可以查看当前价目表（人民币）、峰时规则、数据来源和抓取时间，并可从官网重新抓取。 胶囊样式和原生胶囊（会话统计、Token 用量、上下文用量）保持一致。 使用 DeepSeek Harness 的创造模式完成。 ## 功能 - **实时读数**：按官网规则计算当前时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周一至周五，不含中国法定节假日），并倒计时到下一次切换。 - **人民币价目表**：读取官方中文定价页，显示模型、档位、缓存命中/未命中输入价、输出价，峰/谷两档同时列出，当前生效的一档高亮。 - **从官网更新**：面板里的“立即更新”会读取 ，同时更新价格和峰谷时段规则（时间窗口、星期、是否排除节假日）。 - **自动更新**：启动时以及之后每 30 分钟检查一次，缓存超过 `autoRefreshHours` 小时就在后台重新抓取。抓取失败时保留旧表，并在面板里报告原因。 - **Agent 工具**：`deepseek_price_tip`，`action: status | refresh`，与面板共用同一份数据。 ### 截图展示 ## 安装 本仓库就是插件包本身（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 `dsh.client`），没有构建步骤，也没有第三方依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。 **从 GitHub 安装** 在 Harness 的插件管理里安装这个 bundle，安装 spec 填： ```text github:jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip ``` 也可以让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 用同一个 spec。装好后重启 Harness Web UI，输入框下方就会出现胶囊。 **本地开发时直接 link** 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把依赖指向本目录，并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`： ```json "@local/deepseek-price-tip": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-price-tip" ``` ## 数据与缓存 | 内容 | 位置 | | --- | --- | | 人民币价格、峰时窗口、星期规则 | 首次抓取后写入 `data/pricing-cache.json` | | 内置兜底数据 | `lib/pricing.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PRICING`（2026-10-18 抓取，人民币） | | 中国法定节假日 | 内置 2026 年安排，来源见 `HOLIDAY_SOURCE`；跨年后请用配置补充 | 如果官网表格结构发生大改，解析会失败而不是写入半张表：界面继续显示上一次成功的数据，并提示失败原因。 ## 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给这一行加 `config`： ```yaml - id: deepseek-price-tip name: '@local/deepseek-price-tip' config: autoRefreshHours: 6 # 可选：覆盖峰时窗口，单位是 UTC 零点的分钟数 # peakWindows: [[60, 240], [360, 600]] # 可选：覆盖星期（0 = 周日，6 = 周六） # weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # 可选：追加法定节假日（YYYY-MM-DD） # holidays: ['2027-01-01'] # 可选：换一个抓取地址（英文页会按美元解析并显示 $） # sourceUrl: 'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing' ``` `autoRefreshHours: 0` 关闭自动抓取，只保留手动按钮。 ## 验证 ```powershell npm test ``` 也可以单独跑其中一组： ```powershell node test/pricing.test.mjs # 解析、峰谷计算、节假日、缓存校验 node test/host.test.mjs # Host 路由、刷新、失败回退、Agent 工具 node test/client.test.mjs # Client 注册、locale 字典、样式清理 ``` 不需要 `npm install`：测试只用 Node 内置模块（Node 20+）。GitHub Actions 在 Node 20/22/24 上跑同一套测试，见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`。 安装后在 Harness Web UI 里确认：输入框下方出现胶囊；点开有价目表；点“立即更新”后抓取时间变化。浏览器内的实际渲染效果需要在页面中查看，测试只覆盖模块注册和纯逻辑。 ## 限制 - 峰时窗口支持官网中文页的“北京时间 … 为高峰时段”和英文页的 “Peak hours are … UTC” 两种写法；页面改版时可能需要调整解析器。 - 节假日只内置到 2026 年。2027 年及以后，界面会明确提示“未内置该年节假日”，避免把节假日误报成峰价。 - 价格表按官网当前的“模型列 + 峰/谷行”结构解析；Search & Fetch 的按次计费不在模型价目表内。 - 人民币价格直接取自官方中文页，不是按汇率从美元换算。 - 缓存写在插件包目录里的 `data/pricing-cache.json`（已在 `.gitignore` 中忽略）。重新安装或升级插件会让这份缓存丢失，下次刷新时重新抓取，期间用内置的 `DEFAULT_PRICING` 兜底。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-hot-reload

标题、简介、图标和浏览器模块都按磁盘现读现发布：改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle. It replaces three cached resolvers with plain filesystem
walks, so a plugin's display metadata and browser module follow the package on disk
instead of a verdict cached for the life of the process:

| Service | Why it is patched |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | The Host resolves `locale/*.json` and `icon.svg` through the Node ESM resolver. A package whose export was added after its first read stays bare until restart. |
| `pluginManager.listBundles` | The plugin inventory calls the Host reader directly, so it needs the same disk result even when the Host already produced a fallback. |
| `clientModules.resolveMeta` / `locatePkgJson` | Verdicts are cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser half disappear. |

Install it into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Editing another plugin's `locale/`, `icon.svg`, or manifest then needs only a page
refresh. Editing this plugin's own `index.js`, or adding a new importable subpath
export, still needs a restart: Node caches modules by URL.

## Test

```powershell
$env:DSH_RUNTIME = '<dsh-runtime>'
$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR = '<profile-dir>'
node test/live.test.mjs
```

The check compares this reader against the Host reader for every package the profile
depends on, and reproduces the late-locale case.
